# Owner-directed rendered-product inspection

Source: direct owner instruction of October 13, 2026. Repository copy version: `2026-10-13.1`.
Scope: owner-controlled work across providers, local and cloud runtimes, and current and future workers. Existing owner controls remain in force.

Before calling a client/prospect-facing app, website, dashboard, demo, report, presentation or export ready, the producing worker must open/run/render the exact outgoing version, LOOK at the rendered screen or its real screenshots, and operate the important user controls. Check the actual screenshare width and narrow/mobile width where relevant, populated/empty/loading/error states, downloads/exports and reopening. Capturing screenshots without viewing them is insufficient. Fix ugly, broken, unstyled, cramped, clipped, overflowing or unreadable output within the authorized work before presenting it. Code review, DOM counts, HTTP200, unit checks or another worker's approval do not replace seeing the actual product.

The Ecosystem product requires plain industrial design: readable tables, clear hierarchy, consistent typography/spacing, restrained controls, useful labels and responsive layouts. Keep the real workflows/data/computation. Reviews must lead directly to repairs and must not replace implementation/integration or become endless rechecking. The existing focused-validation policy remains; do not run broad suites or build a verification product.

Persist this instruction in the active owner-controlled instruction surfaces actually read by the relevant workers: global/project AGENTS/CLAUDE/GEMINI/rules, provider-specific boot instructions, source mirrors, cloud repository copies and current build/receiving guides. Include this instruction in every delegated child assignment, including assignments to another provider or runtime. Maintainers update their own consumed files and return exact paths, source/version and readback. A coordination acknowledgment alone is not propagation. Do not alter historical evidence or third-party/vendor policies. No forced restarts, new watchers or revival of owner-stopped work.

Inspect the actual completed scientific screens, reports, source pages and downloadable HTML in the real operator. Prior empty-Workspace screenshots are not completed-workspace acceptance. Preserve current engineering owners; other coordinators receive propagation rather than duplicate implementation. Continue native source/runtime/archive joins rather than diverting everyone to cosmetic review. This instruction does not extend or restart the Ecosystem sprint: the existing cutoff is October 13, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. America/Kentucky/Louisville, 14:00 UTC.

Source assembly and standalone application handoffs retain the application-level instruction copies with their current guides. This file records an owner-requested product delivery requirement; it does not change provider safeguards, repository access controls, or existing authorization boundaries.

## Standing lab rule: inspect the rendered product before presenting it

Bryce's direct owner instruction, October 13, 2026. This applies to every current and future lab peer, provider, model, harness, local session, cloud session, and delegated or child worker.

Before calling a client/prospect-facing app, site, dashboard, demo, report, presentation, or export ready, or putting it before a client/prospect, the responsible producing peer MUST open/run/render the exact outgoing version and visually LOOK at the actual result. Inspect at the actual screenshare/presentation width and at narrow/mobile widths where relevant. Operate critical controls; inspect applicable loaded, empty, loading, and error states; exercise downloads/exports and reopen the delivered files. Capture real screenshots or rendered page images and actually VIEW them. Capturing without viewing does not satisfy this rule.

This includes ALL attachments. Literally observe the actual thing the way a user or recipient would see and use it: open and view downloaded HTML, every relevant PDF/report page, slides, spreadsheets, maps, images, video/audio, archives and project attachments in their normal recipient-facing viewer or application; play audiovisual media and inspect the usable contents of archives/projects. Metadata, schemas, source text, and a browser link do not substitute for opening the attachment and using the delivered result normally.

Fix ugly, cramped, broken, unstyled, clipped, overflowing, or unreadable results within the authorized task before presenting them. Favor simple industrial/plain presentation, consistent spacing and typography, readable tables, and working controls. Do not add decorative template slop. Source review, unit tests, HTTP 200, DOM counts, a reviewer/model approval, or an evidence form do not substitute for looking at and operating the real outgoing product.

This is focused internal product validation, never permission to build or submit a proof, test, or verification product, run broad suites, or repeatedly recheck an unchanged accepted version. Building and integrating the actual deliverable remains the main work; do not substitute endless reviews for delivery. Retain an exact-version visual receipt in the handoff: source/head or artifact hash, URL/file, viewport sizes, screenshots actually viewed, controls/states/export files exercised, fixes, and any precise unresolved gap. A changed outgoing version needs inspection of the affected result.

Bryce explicitly clarified: "that includes all attachments and this does not become review theatre or test theatre you need to literally observe the actual thing the way a user would see and use it". A checklist, screenshot folder, receipt, passing test, or parallel review bureaucracy is not the requirement or a substitute for actual observation and normal use. Perform focused fixes and keep shipping the main work; create no review or approval gate.

Bryce also instructed: "also add that if u make a video use voice gen tts not robot voices, use generative stuff we have models, use them". For video/media narration, use available high-quality generative voice/TTS and applicable generative visual/media capabilities when helpful, with natural professional delivery instead of robotic default voices. Actually play/listen/watch the final exported attachment and inspect clarity, pronunciation, pacing, timing, and audio alignment. Reviewing a text script does not substitute for experiencing the final video/audio. This adds no paid-service purchase or real-person voice-cloning authorization; preserve lab attribution and third-party copyright/license controls.

Pass this rule to child/delegated workers and persist it in owner-controlled provider/project/cloud instruction copies. Record delivery and readback coverage; never claim every running session loaded it without evidence. This rule creates no hooks, watchers, restarts, approval queue, credential restrictions, or new publication authority. Preserve all existing owner rules, including no llama.cpp, no private GitHub repositories or Actions, focused validation, attribution, incident communication, personal meeting approval, contact holds, demo pauses, bounty restrictions, and owner cutoffs.

"""Original public-source preparation for the Upper Savannah workspace."""

"""Prepare retained PRISM/NOAA inputs on one explicit regional model grid.

Uses the maintained native raster aligner and original source-entry contracts.
Completed roles are reusable when another model's inputs arrive later.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import copy
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil

from model.common import (
    atomic_json, describe_file, digest, file_digest, held, now, read_json,
    relative_file, verify_file,
)
from model.rasters import align_source

SCHEMA = "upstate.regional-climate/v1"
UNITS = {
    "PRECIPITATION": "mm/year",
    "R_FACTOR": "MJ*mm/(ha*h*year)",
}


def _within(root, path):
    path = Path(path).resolve(strict=True)
    if not path.is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError(
            "Select one project root above the original inputs, grid and regional outputs: "
            + str(path)
        )
    return path


def load_grid(path):
    """Accept the exact common grid or an existing completed grid record."""
    from pyproj import CRS

    supplied = read_json(path)
    grid = supplied.get("grid", supplied)
    if not isinstance(grid, dict):
        raise ValueError("Select an explicit regional grid definition")
    crs = CRS.from_user_input(grid["crs"])
    if not crs.is_projected or any(
        abs(axis.unit_conversion_factor - 1) > 1e-12 for axis in crs.axis_info[:2]
    ):
        raise ValueError("The regional model grid must use projected metres")
    affine = grid["transform"]
    if len(affine) != 6 or not all(math.isfinite(float(x)) for x in affine):
        raise ValueError("Grid transform must contain six finite affine coefficients")
    a, b, left, d, e, top = (float(x) for x in affine)
    if (not math.isclose(a, 30.0, rel_tol=0, abs_tol=1e-9)
            or not math.isclose(e, -30.0, rel_tol=0, abs_tol=1e-9)
            or abs(b) > 1e-12 or abs(d) > 1e-12):
        raise ValueError("Use the selected north-up, exact 30-metre model grid")
    for field in ("width", "height"):
        if type(grid[field]) is not int or grid[field] <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Grid dimensions must be positive integers")
    bounds = [left, top + e * grid["height"], left + a * grid["width"], top]
    if "bounds" in grid and (
        len(grid["bounds"]) != 4
        or any(not math.isclose(float(x), y, rel_tol=0, abs_tol=1e-6)
               for x, y in zip(grid["bounds"], bounds))
    ):
        raise ValueError("Grid bounds and affine/dimensions disagree")
    if grid.get("grid_sha256"):
        original = {k: v for k, v in grid.items() if k != "grid_sha256"}
        if digest(original) != grid["grid_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("The selected grid changed after its recorded definition")
    # The exact geometry, not an input pathname, identifies the prepared pixels.
    geometry = {
        "crs": crs.to_wkt(), "transform": [a, b, left, d, e, top],
        "width": grid["width"], "height": grid["height"], "bounds": bounds,
    }
    return geometry, digest(geometry)


def _source_entry(root, path, role):
    path = _within(root, path)
    entry = read_json(path)
    if entry.get("kind") != "raster" or entry.get("role") != role:
        raise ValueError("Select a prepared original " + role + " source-entry.json")
    if not all(entry.get(key) for key in ("id", "title", "uri", "vintage")):
        raise ValueError("Keep the original source ID, title, URI and vintage")
    source = verify_file(path.parent, entry)
    _within(root, source)
    companions = []
    for item in entry.get("companions", []):
        companion = verify_file(path.parent, item)
        _within(root, companion)
        companions.append((companion, item))
    conversion = entry.get("conversion")
    if conversion:
        factor = float(conversion["factor"])
        if (not math.isfinite(factor) or factor <= 0
                or not conversion.get("reference")
                or conversion.get("target_units") != UNITS[role]):
            raise ValueError("Keep an explicit, referenced " + role + " unit conversion")
        units = conversion["target_units"]
    else:
        units = entry.get("units")
    if units != UNITS[role]:
        raise ValueError(role + " requires declared " + UNITS[role] + " units")
    if entry.get("resampling", "bilinear") not in ("bilinear", "average", "nearest"):
        raise ValueError("Select a continuous-field resampling method")
    return path, entry, source, companions


def _native_metadata(path):
    import rasterio

    with rasterio.open(path) as src:
        if src.count != 1 or not src.crs:
            raise ValueError("Select a georeferenced single-band original climate input")
        return {
            "crs": src.crs.to_wkt(), "transform": list(src.transform)[:6],
            "width": src.width, "height": src.height,
            "resolution": list(src.res), "dtype": src.dtypes[0],
            "nodata": src.nodata if src.nodata is None or math.isfinite(src.nodata) else None,
            "band_scale": src.scales[0], "band_offset": src.offsets[0],
        }


def _retain_descriptions(root, paths):
    result, seen = [], set()
    for path, metadata in paths:
        actual = describe_file(root, path)
        if actual["path"] in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(actual["path"])
        result.append({**metadata, **actual})
    return result


def prepare_role(root, *, grid_path, grid, grid_id, entry_path, role,
                 directory, resampling=None):
    """Return one ordinary source entry; only its unfinished raster is computed."""
    root = Path(root).resolve(strict=True)
    original_path, original, source, companions = _source_entry(root, entry_path, role)
    grid_path = _within(root, grid_path)
    native = _native_metadata(source)
    method = resampling or original.get("resampling", "bilinear")
    if method not in ("bilinear", "average", "nearest"):
        raise ValueError("Select bilinear, average or nearest continuous-field resampling")
    # GDAL raster reads expose stored values. Conversion from the original source
    # entry already includes its band scale; never apply that scale a second time.
    if native["band_offset"] != 0:
        raise ValueError("This original source needs an explicit additive-offset preparation")
    if native["band_scale"] != 1 and not original.get("conversion"):
        raise ValueError("Keep the original band-scale conversion in the source entry")
    contract = {
        "schema": SCHEMA, "role": role, "grid_id": grid_id,
        "source_entry_sha256": file_digest(original_path),
        "grid_file_sha256": file_digest(grid_path),
        "source_sha256": original["sha256"],
        "conversion": original.get("conversion"), "units": UNITS[role],
        "resampling": method,
    }
    key = digest(contract)
    output_dir = root / directory / role.lower() / key
    if not output_dir.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError("Regional output directory must stay within the selected project")
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    state_path = output_dir / "preparation.json"
    raster_path = output_dir / (role.lower() + ".tif")
    pending = output_dir / (role.lower() + ".partial.tif")
    checkpoint_directory = output_dir / ".alignment"
    with held(output_dir / ".prepare.lock", blocking=False):
        if state_path.exists():
            state = read_json(state_path)
            if state.get("contract") != contract:
                raise ValueError("The retained climate preparation belongs to another selection")
            if state.get("state") == "complete":
                verify_file(root, state["entry"])
                for item in state["entry"]["companions"]:
                    verify_file(root, item)
                shutil.rmtree(checkpoint_directory, ignore_errors=True)
                return state["entry"]
        state = {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "id": key, "contract": contract,
            "state": "preparing", "started_at": now(),
        }
        atomic_json(state_path, state)
        try:
            # A crash may leave only this exact operation's incomplete file. The
            # maintained aligner writes bounded native windows, not full arrays.
            pending.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            stats = align_source(
                source, pending, grid, resampling=method,
                conversion=original.get("conversion"),
                checkpoint_directory=checkpoint_directory,
                source_identity={"source_entry_sha256": contract["source_entry_sha256"],
                                 "source_entry": original},
            )
            # Reuse counters belong to mutable progress; the scientific derivation
            # stays identical when an interrupted role resumes from retained tiles.
            alignment = stats.pop("preparation", None)
            if alignment is not None:
                state["alignment"] = alignment
                atomic_json(state_path, state)
            if not stats["valid_cells"]:
                raise ValueError(role + " has no valid pixels on the selected regional grid")
            if stats["minimum"] is not None and stats["minimum"] < 0:
                raise ValueError(role + " contains negative physical values")
            verify_file(original_path.parent, original)
            if (file_digest(original_path) != contract["source_entry_sha256"]
                    or file_digest(grid_path) != contract["grid_file_sha256"]):
                raise ValueError("The selected source/grid definition changed during alignment")
            for _, companion in companions:
                verify_file(original_path.parent, companion)
            os.replace(pending, raster_path)
            contract_path = output_dir / "derivation.json"
            derivation = {
                **contract, "source_id": original["id"], "source_uri": original["uri"],
                "source_vintage": original["vintage"],
                "native_grid": native, "model_grid": grid,
                "source_resolution": original.get("source_resolution"),
                "statistics": stats,
                "unit_conversion_application": "Applied once by model.rasters.align_source",
                "spatial_meaning": (
                    "The 30-metre working grid retains the resolution and lineage of the "
                    "coarser original field; interpolation does not add observed spatial detail."
                ),
            }
            atomic_json(contract_path, derivation, immutable=True)
            paths = [
                (source, {"role": "ORIGINAL_NUMERIC_SOURCE"}),
                (original_path, {"role": "ORIGINAL_SOURCE_ENTRY"}),
                (grid_path, {"role": "SELECTED_MODEL_GRID"}),
                (contract_path, {"role": "REGIONAL_DERIVATION"}),
            ] + companions
            entry = {
                "id": original["id"] + "-regional-" + key[:20],
                "title": original["title"] + " on the selected regional 30-metre grid",
                "kind": "raster", "role": role, "uri": original["uri"],
                "vintage": original["vintage"], "units": UNITS[role],
                "resampling": method, **describe_file(root, raster_path),
                "companions": _retain_descriptions(root, paths),
                "native_grid": native,
                "model_grid": grid, "regional_grid_id": grid_id,
                "source_resolution": original.get("source_resolution"),
                "derived_from": {
                    "source_id": original["id"], "source_sha256": original["sha256"],
                    "source_entry_sha256": contract["source_entry_sha256"],
                    "native_units": original.get("units"),
                    "applied_conversion": copy.deepcopy(original.get("conversion")),
                },
                "regional_preparation_id": key,
                "citation": original.get("citation"),
                "statistics": stats,
                "use": original.get("use", "Rainfall erosivity input for the original SDR model"),
            }
            # Deliberately no top-level conversion: these stored pixels already
            # have their target units and Workspace must not multiply them again.
            state.update(state="complete", completed_at=now(), entry=entry)
            atomic_json(state_path, state)
            shutil.rmtree(checkpoint_directory, ignore_errors=True)
            return entry
        except Exception as error:
            state.update(state="interrupted", interrupted_at=now(),
                         error={"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)})
            atomic_json(state_path, state)
            raise


def prepare(project_root, *, grid_path, entries, directory="regional-climate",
            resampling=None):
    """Prepare any selected climate roles and emit a source-composer input."""
    root = Path(project_root).resolve(strict=True)
    relative = Path(directory)
    if relative.is_absolute() or not relative.parts or ".." in relative.parts:
        raise ValueError("Use a relative regional-climate output directory")
    if not entries or any(role not in UNITS for role in entries):
        raise ValueError("Select PRECIPITATION and/or R_FACTOR prepared entries")
    grid_path = _within(root, grid_path)
    grid, grid_id = load_grid(grid_path)
    prepared = []
    for role in UNITS:
        if role not in entries:
            continue
        prepared.append(prepare_role(
            root, grid_path=grid_path, grid=grid, grid_id=grid_id,
            entry_path=entries[role], role=role, directory=relative,
            resampling=resampling,
        ))
    identity = digest({"grid_id": grid_id,
                       "sources": [row["regional_preparation_id"] for row in prepared]})
    manifest_path = root / ("regional-climate-" + identity + ".json")
    manifest = {
        "schema": "upstate.sources/v1",
        "title": "Regional precipitation and rainfall erosivity inputs",
        "entries": prepared,
        "scope": {"regional_grid_id": grid_id, "grid": grid,
                  "selected_roles": [entry["role"] for entry in prepared]},
        "notes": [
            "Original raster bodies, metadata, capture records and archive companions remain "
            "under this same project root and are referenced without another large copy.",
            "Physical-unit conversion has already been applied exactly once to the regional "
            "raster. Original source resolution remains attached to each input.",
        ],
    }
    atomic_json(manifest_path, manifest, immutable=True)
    return {
        "schema": SCHEMA, "state": "complete",
        "manifest": str(manifest_path), "manifest_sha256": file_digest(manifest_path),
        "regional_grid_id": grid_id,
        "inputs": {row["role"]: {
            "source_id": row["id"], "path": str(root / row["path"]),
            "sha256": row["sha256"], "units": row["units"],
            "statistics": row["statistics"],
        } for row in prepared},
    }


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--project-root", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--grid", required=True, help="Retained shared regional-grid JSON")
    parser.add_argument("--precipitation-entry", help="Original prepared PRISM source-entry.json")
    parser.add_argument("--erosivity-entry", help="Original prepared NOAA source-entry.json")
    parser.add_argument("--directory", default="regional-climate")
    parser.add_argument("--resampling", choices=("bilinear", "average", "nearest"))
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    entries = {}
    if args.precipitation_entry:
        entries["PRECIPITATION"] = args.precipitation_entry
    if args.erosivity_entry:
        entries["R_FACTOR"] = args.erosivity_entry
    result = prepare(args.project_root, grid_path=args.grid, entries=entries,
                     directory=args.directory, resampling=args.resampling)
    print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Retain NOAA's original CONUS R-factor raster for the existing SDR input.

Capture uses standard-library HTTP/ZIP support. Preparation uses the existing
native raster runtime and preserves the original numeric GeoTIFF.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
from decimal import Decimal
import gzip
import hashlib
from html.parser import HTMLParser
import io
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import stat
import zipfile

from model.common import (atomic_json, describe_file, digest, file_digest,
                          held, now, read_json, retain_file, verify_file)
from .raster_sources import capture, _fsync_directory, _matches

ARCHIVE_URL = "https://coast.noaa.gov/data/digitalcoast/zip/R-Factor-CONUS.zip"
METADATA_URL = "https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/inport/item/48224"
CONVERSION_REFERENCE = "https://storage.googleapis.com/releases.naturalcapitalproject.org/invest-userguide/latest/en/sdr.html"
NATIVE_UNITS = "hundreds*ft*tonf*in/(acre*h*year)"
SI_UNITS = "MJ*mm/(ha*h*year)"
R_TO_SI = Decimal("17.02")
MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES = 256 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_RASTER_BYTES = 512 * 1024 * 1024

class _DocumentText(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.parts = []
        self.skip = 0

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in ("script", "style"):
            self.skip += 1

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in ("script", "style") and self.skip:
            self.skip -= 1

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if not self.skip:
            self.parts.append(data)

def metadata_contract(path):
    original = Path(path).read_bytes()
    if original.startswith(b"\x1f\x8b"):
        with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=io.BytesIO(original)) as archive:
            raw = archive.read(8 * 1024 * 1024 + 1)
        if len(raw) > 8 * 1024 * 1024:
            raise ValueError("The original NOAA metadata exceeds this source's document limit")
    else:
        raw = original
    parser = _DocumentText()
    parser.feed(raw.decode("utf-8-sig"))
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", " ".join(parser.parts))
    required = ("R-Factor for the Conterminous United States",
                "(hundreds ft-tonf-in)/(ac-h-yr)", "800 meter",
                "Albers", "NAD83", "2013-12-26", "1975", "1997",
                "Agriculture Handbook")
    missing = [value for value in required if value not in text]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError("Review the original NOAA metadata before selecting this R source: "
                         + ", ".join(missing))
    return {
        "publisher": "NOAA Office for Coastal Management",
        "identifier": "gov.noaa.nmfs.inport:48224",
        "metadata_url": METADATA_URL,
        "source_period": {"start": "1975", "end": "1997"},
        "publication_date": "2013-12-26",
        "source_reference": "Renard et al. (1997), Agriculture Handbook 703, pages 47-51",
        "published_grid": "800 metre Albers Equal Area, GRS80, NAD83",
        "published_native_units": NATIVE_UNITS,
        "published_method": "Digitized original isoerodents; original NOAA interpolated raster",
        "decoded_metadata_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
        "metadata_encoding": "gzip" if raw is not original else "identity",
    }

def _receipt(root, item, expected_url):
    path = verify_file(root, item)
    receipt = read_json(path.with_name(path.name + ".capture.json"))
    if (receipt.get("url") != expected_url or receipt.get("status") != 200
            or receipt.get("state") not in (None, "complete") or not _matches(path, receipt)):
        raise ValueError("The retained original NOAA response does not match its receipt")
    return path, receipt

def _members(archive_path):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        infos = archive.infolist()
        if not infos or len(infos) > 256 or len({i.filename for i in infos}) != len(infos):
            raise ValueError("The original NOAA archive has an ambiguous or unsupported member inventory")
        members, candidates = [], []
        expanded = 0
        for info in infos:
            name = PurePosixPath(info.filename)
            if (name.is_absolute() or ".." in name.parts or "\\" in info.filename
                    or (name.parts and ":" in name.parts[0])):
                raise ValueError("The original archive has an unsafe member path")
            mode = info.external_attr >> 16
            if stat.S_IFMT(mode) not in (0, stat.S_IFREG, stat.S_IFDIR):
                raise ValueError("Retain only the source archive's original regular members")
            expanded += info.file_size
            members.append({"name": info.filename, "bytes": info.file_size,
                            "compressed_bytes": info.compress_size,
                            "compression": info.compress_type,
                            "crc32": f"{info.CRC:08x}", "directory": info.is_dir()})
            if not info.is_dir() and name.suffix.lower() in (".tif", ".tiff"):
                if info.file_size > MAX_RASTER_BYTES:
                    raise ValueError("The original R-factor raster exceeds the declared native intake")
                candidates.append(info.filename)
        if expanded > 1024 * 1024 * 1024:
            raise ValueError("The original NOAA archive exceeds the declared expanded inventory")
        if not candidates:
            raise ValueError("The original NOAA archive contains no GeoTIFF member")
    return members, candidates

def _capture_manifest(directory, meta_receipt, archive_receipt, *, transferred=False):
    metadata = directory / "metadata.html"
    archive = directory / "noaa-r-factor-conus.zip"
    members, candidates = _members(archive)
    result = {
        "schema": "upstate.noaa-rainfall-erosivity-capture/v1",
        "captured_at": now(), "source_contract": metadata_contract(metadata),
        "archive": describe_file(directory, archive),
        "metadata": describe_file(directory, metadata),
        "archive_receipt": describe_file(directory, archive.with_name(archive.name + ".capture.json")),
        "metadata_receipt": describe_file(directory, metadata.with_name(metadata.name + ".capture.json")),
        "observed_interval": {"start": meta_receipt["requested_at"],
                              "end": archive_receipt["observed_at"]},
        "members": members, "raster_candidates": candidates,
    }
    if transferred:
        result["transfer_receipt"] = describe_file(directory, directory / "source-transfer.json")
    result["capture_id"] = digest(result)
    atomic_json(directory / "capture.json", result, immutable=True)
    return result

def capture_original(directory):
    directory = Path(directory).resolve()
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with held(directory / ".capture.lock"):
        result_path = directory / "capture.json"
        if result_path.exists():
            return read_capture(directory)[0]
        meta_receipt = capture(METADATA_URL, directory / "metadata.html", maximum_bytes=8*1024*1024)
        metadata_contract(directory / "metadata.html")
        archive_receipt = capture(ARCHIVE_URL, directory / "noaa-r-factor-conus.zip",
                                  maximum_bytes=MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES)
        return _capture_manifest(directory, meta_receipt, archive_receipt)

def _received_transfer(path, archive):
    from .source_transfer import received_transfer
    return received_transfer(path, archive, source_url=ARCHIVE_URL, maximum_bytes=MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES)

def receive_original(directory, *, archive_path, transfer_path, metadata_path, metadata_receipt_path):
    """Join received original bytes to the existing capture without a provider request."""
    archive_path = Path(archive_path).resolve(strict=True)
    transfer_path = Path(transfer_path).resolve(strict=True)
    metadata_path = Path(metadata_path).resolve(strict=True)
    metadata_receipt_path = Path(metadata_receipt_path).resolve(strict=True)
    transfer, transferred = _received_transfer(transfer_path, archive_path)
    meta_receipt = read_json(metadata_receipt_path)
    if (meta_receipt.get("url") != METADATA_URL or meta_receipt.get("status") != 200
            or meta_receipt.get("state") not in (None, "complete")
            or not isinstance(meta_receipt.get("requested_at"), str)
            or not _matches(metadata_path, meta_receipt)):
        raise ValueError("Select the retained original NOAA metadata and its actual HTTP receipt")
    metadata_contract(metadata_path)
    directory = Path(directory).resolve()
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with held(directory / ".capture.lock"):
        if (directory / "capture.json").exists():
            captured, _, _ = read_capture(directory)
            if (captured["archive"]["sha256"] != transferred["sha256"]
                    or captured["metadata"]["sha256"] != file_digest(metadata_path)
                    or captured.get("transfer_receipt", {}).get("sha256") != file_digest(transfer_path)):
                raise ValueError("The existing source capture belongs to another received edition")
            return captured
        _retain(archive_path, directory / "noaa-r-factor-conus.zip", transferred, directory)
        _retain(metadata_path, directory / "metadata.html", meta_receipt, directory)
        for original, name in ((metadata_receipt_path, "metadata.html.capture.json"),
                               (transfer_path, "source-transfer.json")):
            expected = {"bytes": original.stat().st_size, "sha256": file_digest(original)}
            _retain(original, directory / name, expected, directory)
        source = transferred["source"]
        archive_receipt = {
            "schema": "upstate.received-public-source/v1", "state": "complete",
            "url": ARCHIVE_URL, "final_url": source["final_url"], "status": 200,
            "source_header_observed_at": source["observed_at"],
            "observed_at": transfer["body"]["streamed_at"],
            "bytes": transferred["bytes"], "sha256": transferred["sha256"],
            "headers": {name: source[key] for name, key in
                        (("Content-Type", "content_type"), ("ETag", "etag"), ("Last-Modified", "last_modified"))
                        if source.get(key) is not None},
            "capture_method": "Original SourceArtifacts HTTP-200 stream and completed file handoff",
            "transfer_operation_id": transfer["operation_id"],
            "transfer_file_id": transferred["file_id"],
            "transfer_receipt_sha256": file_digest(transfer_path),
        }
        atomic_json(directory / "noaa-r-factor-conus.zip.capture.json", archive_receipt, immutable=True)
        return _capture_manifest(directory, meta_receipt, archive_receipt, transferred=True)

def read_capture(directory):
    directory = Path(directory).resolve(strict=True)
    result = read_json(directory / "capture.json")
    if result.get("schema") != "upstate.noaa-rainfall-erosivity-capture/v1":
        raise ValueError("Select the retained original NOAA source capture")
    identity = dict(result)
    selected_id = identity.pop("capture_id", None)
    if digest(identity) != selected_id:
        raise ValueError("The retained NOAA capture identity changed")
    for field in ("archive_receipt", "metadata_receipt", "transfer_receipt"):
        if field in result:
            verify_file(directory, result[field])
    archive, _ = _receipt(directory, result["archive"], ARCHIVE_URL)
    metadata, _ = _receipt(directory, result["metadata"], METADATA_URL)
    if "transfer_receipt" in result:
        _received_transfer(verify_file(directory, result["transfer_receipt"]), archive)
    if metadata_contract(metadata) != result["source_contract"]:
        raise ValueError("The original NOAA source contract differs")
    members, candidates = _members(archive)
    if members != result["members"] or candidates != result["raster_candidates"]:
        raise ValueError("The original NOAA archive inventory differs")
    return result, archive, metadata

def _retain(source, destination, expected, root):
    source, destination, root = Path(source).resolve(strict=True), Path(destination), Path(root)
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if destination.exists():
        if not _matches(destination, expected):
            raise ValueError("The retained NOAA source member differs: " + str(destination))
        return destination
    if source == destination.resolve():
        raise ValueError("Original source member unexpectedly disappeared")
    try:
        os.link(source, destination)
    except OSError as error:
        import errno
        if error.errno != errno.EXDEV:
            raise
        saved = retain_file(root, source, expected["sha256"])
        os.link(root / saved["object"], destination)
    if not _matches(destination, expected):
        raise ValueError("Original source bytes changed during handoff")
    _fsync_directory(destination.parent)
    return destination

def _extract_original(archive_path, member_name, directory, plan):
    destination = directory / "rainfall-erosivity-native.tif"
    pending = directory / "rainfall-erosivity-native.tif.partial"
    receipt_path = directory / "native-member.json"
    plan_sha = digest(plan)
    if receipt_path.exists():
        receipt = read_json(receipt_path)
        if receipt.get("plan_sha256") != plan_sha or receipt.get("state") not in ("received", "complete"):
            raise ValueError("The retained original-raster extraction belongs to another selection")
        selected = destination if destination.exists() else pending
        if not _matches(selected, receipt):
            raise ValueError("The retained original R-factor member differs")
        if selected == pending:
            os.replace(pending, destination)
            _fsync_directory(directory)
        if receipt["state"] != "complete":
            receipt["state"] = "complete"
            atomic_json(receipt_path, receipt)
        return destination
    if destination.exists():
        raise ValueError("Reconcile the original R raster that has no extraction receipt")
    h, size = hashlib.sha256(), 0
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        info = archive.getinfo(member_name)
        with archive.open(info) as source, pending.open("wb") as output:
            for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024*1024), b""):
                size += len(block)
                if size > info.file_size or size > MAX_RASTER_BYTES:
                    raise ValueError("Original R-factor member exceeds its declared length")
                h.update(block)
                output.write(block)
            if size != info.file_size:
                raise ValueError("Original R-factor member is incomplete")
            output.flush()
            os.fsync(output.fileno())
        receipt = {"schema": "upstate.original-raster-member/v1",
                   "state": "received", "plan_sha256": plan_sha,
                   "archive_sha256": plan["archive_sha256"],
                   "member": info.filename, "member_crc32": f"{info.CRC:08x}",
                   "bytes": size, "sha256": h.hexdigest(), "received_at": now()}
    atomic_json(receipt_path, receipt)
    os.replace(pending, destination)
    _fsync_directory(directory)
    receipt["state"] = "complete"
    atomic_json(receipt_path, receipt)
    return destination

def _native_grid(path):
    import numpy as np
    import rasterio
    from pyproj import CRS
    with rasterio.Env(GDAL_CACHEMAX=64*1024*1024), rasterio.open(path) as source:
        if source.driver != "GTiff" or source.count != 1 or not source.crs:
            raise ValueError("Select the original NOAA single-band numeric GeoTIFF")
        crs = CRS.from_user_input(source.crs)
        units = [a.unit_conversion_factor for a in crs.axis_info[:2]]
        method = crs.coordinate_operation.method_name if crs.coordinate_operation else ""
        datum = crs.datum.name if crs.datum else ""
        if (not crs.is_projected or len(units) != 2 or any(abs(v-1) > 1e-10 for v in units)
                or "albers" not in method.lower()
                or not ("north american" in datum.lower().replace("_", " ") and "1983" in datum)):
            raise ValueError("The original R-factor CRS differs from NOAA's published Albers/NAD83 grid")
        t = source.transform
        if (t.b or t.d or not math.isclose(t.a, 800, abs_tol=1e-7)
                or not math.isclose(t.e, -800, abs_tol=1e-7)):
            raise ValueError("The original NOAA raster differs from its published 800 metre grid")
        scale, offset = float(source.scales[0]), float(source.offsets[0])
        if not math.isfinite(scale) or scale <= 0 or offset != 0:
            raise ValueError("The original raster needs a different explicit physical conversion")
        low, high, valid, missing = None, None, 0, 0
        for _, window in source.block_windows(1):
            values = source.read(1, window=window, masked=True)
            raw = np.ma.getdata(values)
            masked = np.ma.getmaskarray(values)
            if np.any(~masked & ~np.isfinite(raw)):
                raise ValueError("Original R-factor contains unmasked nonfinite values")
            good = raw[~masked]
            if np.any(good < 0):
                raise ValueError("Original R-factor contains negative physical values")
            valid += int(good.size)
            missing += int(masked.sum())
            if good.size:
                low = float(good.min()) if low is None else min(low, float(good.min()))
                high = float(good.max()) if high is None else max(high, float(good.max()))
        if not valid or high <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Original NOAA raster has no positive rainfall-erosivity values")
        nodata = source.nodata
        if nodata is not None and not math.isfinite(nodata):
            nodata = str(nodata)
        return {"crs": crs.to_wkt(), "crs_name": crs.to_string(), "datum": datum,
                "transform": list(t)[:6], "resolution_m": [float(x) for x in source.res],
                "width": source.width, "height": source.height, "dtype": source.dtypes[0],
                "nodata": nodata, "band_scale": str(scale), "band_offset": str(offset),
                "native_tags": source.tags(), "native_band_tags": source.tags(1),
                "image_structure": source.tags(ns="IMAGE_STRUCTURE"),
                "valid_cells": valid, "nodata_cells": missing,
                "minimum_stored_value": low, "maximum_stored_value": high}

def prepare(directory, *, capture_directory=None, raster_member=None):
    directory = Path(directory).resolve()
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with held(directory / ".prepare.lock"):
        if capture_directory is None:
            capture_directory = directory / "original"
            capture_original(capture_directory)
        capture_directory = Path(capture_directory).resolve(strict=True)
        captured, original_archive, metadata = read_capture(capture_directory)
        candidates = captured["raster_candidates"]
        if raster_member is None:
            if len(candidates) != 1:
                raise ValueError("Select one actual original GeoTIFF from the retained raster_candidates")
            raster_member = candidates[0]
        if raster_member not in candidates:
            raise ValueError("Selected raster member is absent from the original capture")
        plan = {"schema": "upstate.noaa-rainfall-erosivity-source/v1",
                "capture_id": captured["capture_id"],
                "capture_sha256": file_digest(capture_directory / "capture.json"),
                "archive_sha256": captured["archive"]["sha256"],
                "metadata_sha256": captured["metadata"]["sha256"],
                "raster_member": raster_member, "source_contract": captured["source_contract"],
                "unit_conversion_factor": str(R_TO_SI), "target_units": SI_UNITS,
                "unit_conversion_reference": CONVERSION_REFERENCE,
                "resampling": "bilinear"}
        atomic_json(directory / "plan.json", plan, immutable=True)
        result_path = directory / "source-entry.json"
        if result_path.exists():
            entry = read_json(result_path)
            if entry["preparation_sha256"] != digest(plan):
                raise ValueError("The original R-factor preparation selection changed")
            verify_file(directory, entry)
            for item in entry["companions"]:
                verify_file(directory, item)
            atomic_json(directory / "source-manifest.json",
                        {"schema": "upstate.sources/v1", "title": entry["title"], "entries": [entry]},
                        immutable=True)
            return entry
        retained = []
        for field in ("archive", "metadata", "archive_receipt", "metadata_receipt", "transfer_receipt"):
            if field not in captured:
                continue
            item = captured[field]
            source = verify_file(capture_directory, item)
            target = directory / "original" / item["path"]
            retained.append(_retain(source, target, item, directory))
        capture_file = capture_directory / "capture.json"
        captured_item = describe_file(capture_directory, capture_file)
        retained.append(_retain(capture_file, directory / "original/capture.json",
                                captured_item, directory))
        destination = _extract_original(directory / "original" / captured["archive"]["path"],
                                        raster_member, directory, plan)
        native = _native_grid(destination)
        factor = R_TO_SI * Decimal(native["band_scale"])
        companions = [describe_file(directory, p) for p in retained]
        companions.extend(describe_file(directory, directory / name)
                          for name in ("plan.json", "native-member.json"))
        entry = {
            "id": "noaa-r-factor-conus-2013-" + captured["archive"]["sha256"][:16],
            "title": "NOAA CONUS original rainfall-runoff erosivity",
            "kind": "raster", "role": "R_FACTOR", "uri": ARCHIVE_URL,
            "vintage": "2013 publication of 1975-1997/AH703 source isoerodents",
            "units": NATIVE_UNITS, "resampling": "bilinear",
            **describe_file(directory, destination), "native_grid": native,
            "preparation_sha256": digest(plan), "companions": companions,
            "conversion": {"factor": str(factor), "target_units": SI_UNITS,
                           "reference": CONVERSION_REFERENCE,
                           "native_unit_reference": METADATA_URL,
                           "unit_factor": str(R_TO_SI),
                           "source_band_scale": native["band_scale"],
                           "application": "Once during the existing model grid preparation"},
            "source_contract": captured["source_contract"],
            "source_capture_id": captured["capture_id"],
            "source_resolution": "Original 800 metre grid, retained unchanged",
            "selection_note": "A named historical R reference. Source resolution and original "
                              "isoerodent lineage remain visible when aligned to the model's 30m grid.",
        }
        atomic_json(result_path, entry, immutable=True)
        atomic_json(directory / "source-manifest.json",
                    {"schema": "upstate.sources/v1", "title": entry["title"], "entries": [entry]},
                    immutable=True)
        return entry

def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    c = sub.add_parser("capture", help="Retain the original NOAA archive, metadata and HTTP receipts")
    c.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    receive = sub.add_parser("receive", help="Open a completed original archive transfer without another HTTP capture")
    receive.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    receive.add_argument("--archive", required=True)
    receive.add_argument("--transfer", required=True)
    receive.add_argument("--metadata", required=True)
    receive.add_argument("--metadata-receipt", required=True)
    p = sub.add_parser("prepare", help="Prepare the original numeric R raster for the model source composer")
    p.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--capture-directory", help="Reuse a complete original capture without HTTP requests")
    p.add_argument("--raster-member", help="Select an actual member from the original archive inventory")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.command == "capture":
        result = capture_original(args.output)
    elif args.command == "receive":
        result = receive_original(args.output, archive_path=args.archive,
                                  transfer_path=args.transfer, metadata_path=args.metadata,
                                  metadata_receipt_path=args.metadata_receipt)
    else:
        result = prepare(args.output, capture_directory=args.capture_directory,
                         raster_member=args.raster_member)
    import json
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Original public raster intake for the Upper Savannah scientific workspace.

Run these commands inside the existing native GIS job. No model is executed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import hashlib
import gzip
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import tempfile
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
import zipfile
from model.common import atomic_json, describe_file, digest, file_digest, held, now, read_json

DEM_SERVICE = "https://elevation.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/3DEPElevation/ImageServer"
PRISM_ANNUAL = "https://data.prism.oregonstate.edu/normals/us/800m/ppt/monthly/prism_ppt_us_30s_2020_avg_30y.zip"
EXPORT_REFERENCE = "https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/services-reference/enterprise/export-image/"
PRISM_REFERENCE = "https://prism.oregonstate.edu/normals/"
HEADERS = ("Date", "ETag", "Last-Modified", "Content-Type", "Content-Length",
           "Content-Encoding", "Accept-Ranges", "Retry-After")

def _fsync_directory(path):
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)

def _matches(path, record):
    return (path.is_file() and path.stat().st_size == record["bytes"]
            and file_digest(path) == record["sha256"])

def capture(url, path, *, maximum_bytes):
    """Retain one full HTTP entity and reuse its completed exact-byte receipt."""
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    receipt_path = path.with_name(path.name + ".capture.json")
    partial = path.with_name(path.name + ".partial")
    with held(path.with_name(path.name + ".lock")):
        prior = read_json(receipt_path) if receipt_path.exists() else None
        if prior and prior["url"] != url:
            raise ValueError("Select a separate source directory for a different request")
        if prior and prior.get("state") in ("received", "complete"):
            selected = path if path.exists() else partial
            if not _matches(selected, prior):
                raise ValueError("Retained HTTP source bytes differ: " + str(selected))
            if selected == partial:
                os.replace(partial, path)
                _fsync_directory(path.parent)
            if prior["state"] != "complete":
                prior["state"] = "complete"
                atomic_json(receipt_path, prior)
            return prior
        if path.exists():
            raise ValueError("A source body exists without its complete capture receipt")
        attempt = (prior or {}).get("attempt", 0) + 1
        request_record = {"schema": "upstate.public-source-capture/v1", "url": url,
                          "state": "receiving", "requested_at": now(), "attempt": attempt}
        if prior:
            request_record["previous_attempt"] = {
                k: prior[k] for k in ("attempt", "requested_at", "observed_at", "status", "error", "received_bytes")
                if k in prior}
        atomic_json(receipt_path, request_record)
        received = 0
        h = hashlib.sha256()
        try:
            request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={
                "User-Agent": "Commons-Upper-Savannah-Source/1.0", "Accept-Encoding": "identity"})
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=60) as response, partial.open("wb") as out:
                record = {**request_record, "status": response.status, "final_url": response.url,
                          "headers": {k: response.headers[k] for k in HEADERS if k in response.headers}}
                atomic_json(receipt_path, record)
                if response.status != 200:
                    raise ValueError("Source request did not return the complete HTTP entity")
                for block in iter(lambda: response.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                    received += len(block)
                    if received > maximum_bytes:
                        raise ValueError("Original HTTP entity exceeds this source's declared maximum")
                    out.write(block)
                    h.update(block)
                length = response.headers.get("Content-Length")
                if length is not None and received != int(length):
                    raise ValueError("Original HTTP entity is incomplete")
                out.flush()
                os.fsync(out.fileno())
            record.update(state="received", observed_at=now(), bytes=received, sha256=h.hexdigest())
            atomic_json(receipt_path, record)
            os.replace(partial, path)
            _fsync_directory(path.parent)
            record["state"] = "complete"
            atomic_json(receipt_path, record)
            return record
        except BaseException as error:
            current = read_json(receipt_path)
            if current.get("state") not in ("received", "complete"):
                current.update(state="interrupted", observed_at=now(), received_bytes=received,
                               error=type(error).__name__ + ": " + str(error))
                if isinstance(error, urllib.error.HTTPError):
                    current.update(status=error.code, final_url=error.url,
                                   headers={k: error.headers[k] for k in HEADERS if k in error.headers})
                atomic_json(receipt_path, current)
            raise

def source_grid(reference, domain, *, layer=None, where=None, buffer_m=1000):
    from model import rasters
    import rasterio
    from pyproj import CRS
    if not math.isfinite(buffer_m) or buffer_m <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Supply the explicit positive model-domain buffer in metres")
    with rasterio.open(reference) as dataset:
        target = CRS.from_user_input(dataset.crs)
    rows, _ = rasters.vector_geometry(domain, layer=layer, where=where, target_crs=target)
    geometry = rasters.polygon_union(rows).buffer(buffer_m)
    grid = rasters.grid_definition(reference, geometry)
    return grid

def _tile_requests(grid, maximum, *, image_sr=None):
    width, height = grid["width"], grid["height"]
    a, b, left, d, e, top = grid["transform"]
    if b or d or a != 30 or e != -30:
        raise ValueError("DEM preparation requires the retained unrotated 30m reference grid")
    from pyproj import CRS
    reference_crs = CRS.from_user_input(grid["crs"])
    if image_sr is None:
        epsg = reference_crs.to_epsg()
        image_sr = str(epsg) if epsg else json.dumps({"wkt": grid["crs"]}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif not isinstance(image_sr, str) or not image_sr:
        raise ValueError("The original request coordinate system is missing")
    elif re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*", image_sr):
        if not reference_crs.equals(CRS.from_epsg(int(image_sr)), ignore_axis_order=True):
            raise ValueError("The original numeric request CRS differs from its saved grid")
    elif image_sr != json.dumps({"wkt": grid["crs"]}, separators=(",", ":")):
        raise ValueError("The original request WKT differs from its saved grid")
    for row in range(0, height, maximum):
        for col in range(0, width, maximum):
            w, h = min(maximum, width-col), min(maximum, height-row)
            bbox = [left + col*a, top + (row+h)*e, left + (col+w)*a, top + row*e]
            query = {
                "f": "image", "bbox": ",".join(format(value, ".17g") for value in bbox),
                "bboxSR": image_sr, "imageSR": image_sr, "size": f"{w},{h}",
                "adjustAspectRatio": "false", "format": "tiff", "pixelType": "F32",
                "bandIds": "0", "renderingRule": '{"rasterFunction":"None"}',
                "interpolation": "RSP_BilinearInterpolation", "compression": "LZ77"}
            yield {"row": row, "col": col, "width": w, "height": h, "bbox": bbox,
                   "file": f"original/3dep-r{row:06d}-c{col:06d}.tif",
                   "url": DEM_SERVICE + "/exportImage?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(query)}

def plan_dem(reference, domain, metadata_path, directory, *, vintage, layer=None,
             where=None, buffer_m=1000, tile_size=2048):
    """Save the original grid and requests before acquisition on any worker."""
    directory = Path(directory)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if not isinstance(vintage, str) or not vintage.strip():
        raise ValueError("Supply the retained elevation service edition")
    if isinstance(tile_size, bool) or not isinstance(tile_size, int):
        raise ValueError("Tile size must be an integer number of reference pixels")
    with held(directory / "prepare.lock", blocking=False):
        grid = source_grid(reference, domain, layer=layer, where=where, buffer_m=buffer_m)
        metadata_bytes = Path(metadata_path).read_bytes()
        metadata_encoding = "gzip" if metadata_bytes.startswith(bytes((0x1F, 0x8B))) else "identity"
        decoded_metadata = gzip.decompress(metadata_bytes) if metadata_encoding == "gzip" else metadata_bytes
        metadata = json.loads(decoded_metadata)
        metadata_filename = "original/service.json" + (".gz" if metadata_encoding == "gzip" else "")
        available = [int(metadata.get("maxImageWidth", 0)), int(metadata.get("maxImageHeight", 0))]
        if (metadata.get("bandCount") != 1 or metadata.get("pixelType") != "F32"
                or "Image" not in metadata.get("capabilities", "")):
            raise ValueError("Select the retained original 3DEP elevation ImageServer metadata")
        if tile_size < 1 or min(available) < tile_size:
            raise ValueError("Tile dimensions exceed the observed original image-service limit")
        functions = [item.get("name") for item in metadata.get("rasterFunctionInfos", [])]
        if "None" not in functions:
            raise ValueError("The observed elevation service does not advertise its unrendered data path")
        plan = {"schema": "upstate.3dep-native-source/v1", "source": DEM_SERVICE, "vintage": vintage,
                "reference_sha256": file_digest(reference), "domain_sha256": file_digest(domain),
                "domain_layer": layer, "domain_filter": where, "buffer_m": buffer_m,
                "metadata_sha256": hashlib.sha256(metadata_bytes).hexdigest(),
                "metadata_decoded_sha256": hashlib.sha256(decoded_metadata).hexdigest(),
                "metadata_encoding": metadata_encoding, "metadata_file": metadata_filename,
                "grid": grid, "tile_size": tile_size,
                "interpolation": "RSP_BilinearInterpolation", "pixel_type": "F32",
                "rendering_rule": {"rasterFunction": "None"}, "compression": "LZ77",
                "mosaic_rule": {"selection": "observed provider default",
                               "defaultMosaicMethod": metadata.get("defaultMosaicMethod"),
                               "mosaicOperator": metadata.get("mosaicOperator"),
                               "sortField": metadata.get("sortField"), "sortValue": metadata.get("sortValue")},
                "export_contract": EXPORT_REFERENCE}
        atomic_json(directory / "plan.json", plan, immutable=True)

        from model.common import atomic_bytes
        original_metadata = directory / metadata_filename
        atomic_bytes(original_metadata, metadata_bytes, immutable=True)
        requests = list(_tile_requests(grid, tile_size))
        atomic_json(directory / "requests.json",
                    {"plan_sha256": digest(plan), "tiles": requests}, immutable=True)
        return {"schema": "upstate.3dep-plan-result/v1",
                "directory": str(directory.resolve()), "plan_sha256": digest(plan),
                "tile_count": len(requests), "grid": grid,
                "uncompressed_mosaic_bytes": grid["width"] * grid["height"] * 4,
                "metadata_file": metadata_filename,
                "plan_file": "plan.json", "requests_file": "requests.json"}

def _load_dem_plan(directory):
    directory = Path(directory)
    plan = read_json(directory / "plan.json")
    if (plan.get("schema") != "upstate.3dep-native-source/v1"
            or plan.get("source") != DEM_SERVICE):
        raise ValueError("Select an original 3DEP source plan")
    grid = plan["grid"]
    for name in ("width", "height"):
        value = grid.get(name)
        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value <= 0:
            raise ValueError("The retained DEM grid has invalid " + name)
    size = plan["tile_size"]
    if isinstance(size, bool) or not isinstance(size, int) or size <= 0:
        raise ValueError("The retained DEM tile size must be positive")
    from model.common import relative_file
    metadata_path = relative_file(directory, plan["metadata_file"])
    metadata_bytes = metadata_path.read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(metadata_bytes).hexdigest() != plan["metadata_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("The original elevation service metadata changed")
    decoded = gzip.decompress(metadata_bytes) if plan.get("metadata_encoding") == "gzip" else metadata_bytes
    if hashlib.sha256(decoded).hexdigest() != plan["metadata_decoded_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("The original decoded elevation metadata changed")
    metadata = json.loads(decoded)
    if (metadata.get("bandCount") != 1 or metadata.get("pixelType") != "F32"
            or "Image" not in metadata.get("capabilities", "")
            or "None" not in [x.get("name") for x in metadata.get("rasterFunctionInfos", [])]
            or size > min(int(metadata.get("maxImageWidth", 0)),
                          int(metadata.get("maxImageHeight", 0)))):
        raise ValueError("The retained DEM request is incompatible with its service metadata")
    expected = {"pixel_type": "F32", "rendering_rule": {"rasterFunction": "None"},
                "interpolation": "RSP_BilinearInterpolation", "compression": "LZ77"}
    if any(plan.get(key) != value for key, value in expected.items()):
        raise ValueError("The source plan no longer uses its original numeric elevation request")
    request_path = directory / "requests.json"
    if request_path.exists():
        requests = read_json(request_path)
        if (not isinstance(requests, dict) or set(requests) != {"plan_sha256", "tiles"}
                or requests["plan_sha256"] != digest(plan)
                or not isinstance(requests["tiles"], list) or not requests["tiles"]
                or not isinstance(requests["tiles"][0], dict)
                or not isinstance(requests["tiles"][0].get("url"), str)):
            raise ValueError("The saved requests no longer bind the original source plan")
        # Preserve the original wire CRS across GIS versions: authority inference
        # can change while the retained WKT, source grid and requests stay the same.
        query = urllib.parse.parse_qs(
            urllib.parse.urlsplit(requests["tiles"][0]["url"]).query,
            keep_blank_values=True, strict_parsing=True)
        spatial_references = query.get("imageSR", [])
        if len(spatial_references) != 1:
            raise ValueError("The original request has no unique coordinate system")
        tiles = list(_tile_requests(grid, size, image_sr=spatial_references[0]))
        if requests != {"plan_sha256": digest(plan), "tiles": tiles}:
            raise ValueError("The original tile requests changed")
    else:
        # Existing one-command preparations predate the separate request carrier.
        tiles = list(_tile_requests(grid, size))
    return plan, tiles


def _dem_tile_record(directory, tile, grid, *, verify=True):
    """Inspect an original tile and its complete HTTP receipt."""
    import rasterio
    from rasterio.transform import Affine
    from pyproj import CRS
    path = Path(directory) / tile["file"]
    receipt = read_json(path.with_name(path.name + ".capture.json"))
    if (receipt.get("state") != "complete" or receipt.get("status") != 200
            or receipt.get("url") != tile["url"]
            or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size != receipt.get("bytes")):
        raise ValueError("An elevation tile has no matching complete HTTP entity: " + tile["file"])
    if verify and file_digest(path) != receipt.get("sha256"):
        raise ValueError("Original elevation tile bytes changed: " + tile["file"])
    with rasterio.open(path) as actual:
        expected = Affine(*grid["transform"]) * Affine.translation(tile["col"], tile["row"])
        if (actual.count != 1 or actual.width != tile["width"] or actual.height != tile["height"]
                or actual.dtypes[0] != "float32"
                or actual.crs != CRS.from_user_input(grid["crs"])
                or not actual.transform.almost_equals(expected, precision=1e-7)):
            raise ValueError("Returned original elevation tile differs from its exact requested grid: "
                             + tile["file"])
    return {**tile, "capture": {key: receipt[key] for key in
                              ("bytes", "sha256", "requested_at", "observed_at")}}


def _dem_complete_entry(directory, plan):
    path = Path(directory) / "source-entry.json"
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    entry = read_json(path)
    if entry.get("preparation_sha256") != digest(plan):
        raise ValueError("This prepared DEM belongs to another source grid")
    for item in [entry, *entry["companions"]]:
        if not _matches(Path(directory) / item["path"], item):
            raise ValueError("Prepared DEM or original companion bytes changed: " + item["path"])
    return entry


def dem_status(directory, *, verify=False):
    """Read useful acquisition state without acquiring a job lock or requesting data."""
    directory = Path(directory)
    plan, tiles = _load_dem_plan(directory)
    counts = {"ready": 0, "pending": 0, "incomplete": 0, "invalid": 0}
    rows = []
    retained_bytes = 0
    for tile in tiles:
        path = directory / tile["file"]
        receipt_path = path.with_name(path.name + ".capture.json")
        row = {key: tile[key] for key in ("file", "row", "col", "width", "height")}
        row["state"] = "pending"
        if receipt_path.exists():
            try:
                receipt = read_json(receipt_path)
                if (receipt.get("url") != tile["url"]):
                    row.update(state="invalid", error="Receipt belongs to a different request")
                elif (receipt.get("state") == "complete" and receipt.get("status") == 200
                      and path.is_file() and path.stat().st_size == receipt.get("bytes")):
                    if verify:
                        _dem_tile_record(directory, tile, plan["grid"], verify=True)
                    row.update(state="ready", bytes=receipt["bytes"], sha256=receipt["sha256"])
                    retained_bytes += receipt["bytes"]
                else:
                    row.update(state="incomplete", capture_state=receipt.get("state"),
                               status=receipt.get("status"), received_bytes=receipt.get("received_bytes", 0))
                    for key in ("error", "requested_at", "observed_at"):
                        if key in receipt:
                            row[key] = receipt[key]
                    headers = receipt.get("headers", {})
                    if headers.get("Retry-After") is not None:
                        row["retry_after"] = headers["Retry-After"]
            except (ValueError, OSError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
                row.update(state="invalid", error=type(error).__name__ + ": " + str(error))
        elif path.exists():
            row.update(state="invalid", error="Original body has no HTTP receipt")
        counts[row["state"]] += 1
        rows.append(row)
    result = {"schema": "upstate.3dep-status/v1", "plan_sha256": digest(plan),
              "directory": str(directory.resolve()), "observed_at": now(),
              "counts": counts, "tile_count": len(tiles), "retained_bytes": retained_bytes,
              "tile_checks": "bytes, hashes and TIFF grid" if verify else "receipt and file size",
              "ready_fraction": counts["ready"] / len(tiles) if tiles else 0,
              "tiles": rows, "grid": plan["grid"], "state": "acquiring"}
    if counts["ready"] == len(tiles):
        result["state"] = "ready-to-assemble"
    entry_path = directory / "source-entry.json"
    if entry_path.exists():
        try:
            entry = _dem_complete_entry(directory, plan) if verify else read_json(entry_path)
            if (counts["ready"] != len(tiles)
                    or entry.get("preparation_sha256") != digest(plan)
                    or not (directory / entry["path"]).is_file()
                    or (directory / entry["path"]).stat().st_size != entry["bytes"]):
                raise ValueError("The source entry does not match its retained mosaic")
            result.update(state="complete", source_entry=entry)
        except (ValueError, OSError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
            result.update(state="invalid-output", output_error=type(error).__name__ + ": " + str(error))
    progress_path = directory / "acquisition-progress.json"
    if progress_path.exists():
        result["last_acquisition"] = read_json(progress_path)
    assembly_path = directory / "assembly-progress.json"
    if assembly_path.exists():
        result["last_assembly"] = read_json(assembly_path)
    return result


def acquire_dem(directory, *, workers=1, progress=None):
    """Acquire the existing original requests; every completed tile survives interruption.

    Worker count affects concurrency only, never grid, tile size or source identity.
    Provider throttling stops new dispatch and records its actual Retry-After.
    Re-enter this operation to reuse completed captures; each URL is attempted once
    per invocation and the original per-file locks prevent a duplicate writer.
    """
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, wait, FIRST_COMPLETED
    import time
    if isinstance(workers, bool) or not isinstance(workers, int) or workers <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Workers must be a positive integer")
    directory = Path(directory)
    with held(directory / "prepare.lock", blocking=False):
        plan, tiles = _load_dem_plan(directory)
        started = now()
        clock = time.monotonic()
        rows = [{"file": tile["file"], "state": "pending"} for tile in tiles]
        progress_path = directory / "acquisition-progress.json"
        stop_dispatch = False
        deferred_reason = None
        next_index = 0
        futures = {}
        records = {}
        failures = []

        def publish(state):
            completed = sum(row["state"] == "complete" for row in rows)
            report = {"schema": "upstate.3dep-acquisition/v1", "plan_sha256": digest(plan),
                      "state": state, "started_at": started, "updated_at": now(),
                      "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - clock, 6),
                      "workers": workers, "tile_count": len(tiles), "complete_tiles": completed,
                      "failed_tiles": len(failures), "pending_tiles": sum(
                          row["state"] == "pending" for row in rows),
                      "received_bytes": sum(row.get("bytes", 0) for row in rows),
                      "reused_tiles": sum(row.get("reused", False) for row in rows),
                      "tiles": rows}
            if deferred_reason:
                report["provider_deferral"] = deferred_reason
            atomic_json(progress_path, report)
            if progress:
                progress({key: value for key, value in report.items() if key != "tiles"})
            return report

        def one(index):
            tile = tiles[index]
            path = directory / tile["file"]
            receipt_path = path.with_name(path.name + ".capture.json")
            reused = False
            if receipt_path.exists():
                previous = read_json(receipt_path)
                reused = previous.get("state") == "complete" and path.is_file()
            capture(tile["url"], path, maximum_bytes=tile["width"] * tile["height"] * 6 + 4 * 1024 * 1024)
            record = _dem_tile_record(directory, tile, plan["grid"], verify=True)
            return record, reused

        executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers, thread_name_prefix="upstate-3dep")
        publish("acquiring")
        try:
            while next_index < len(tiles) or futures:
                while not stop_dispatch and next_index < len(tiles) and len(futures) < workers:
                    index = next_index
                    next_index += 1
                    rows[index]["state"] = "receiving"
                    futures[executor.submit(one, index)] = index
                if not futures:
                    break
                done, _ = wait(futures, return_when=FIRST_COMPLETED)
                for future in sorted(done, key=lambda f: futures[f]):
                    index = futures.pop(future)
                    try:
                        record, reused = future.result()
                        records[index] = record
                        rows[index].update(state="complete", reused=reused, **record["capture"])
                    except Exception as error:
                        failure = {"file": tiles[index]["file"], "state": "failed",
                                   "error": type(error).__name__ + ": " + str(error)}
                        if isinstance(error, urllib.error.HTTPError):
                            failure["status"] = error.code
                            after = error.headers.get("Retry-After") if error.headers else None
                            if after is not None:
                                failure["retry_after"] = after
                            if error.code in (401, 403, 429) or (error.code == 503 and after is not None):
                                stop_dispatch = True
                                deferred_reason = {key: value for key, value in failure.items()
                                                   if key != "state"}
                        rows[index] = failure
                        failures.append(failure)
                    publish("draining" if stop_dispatch else "acquiring")
            if failures or len(records) != len(tiles):
                report = publish("deferred" if stop_dispatch else "incomplete")
                first = failures[0]["error"] if failures else "Some original tiles remain pending"
                raise RuntimeError(f"DEM acquisition retained {len(records)}/{len(tiles)} tiles. "
                                   f"{first}. Continue the same directory after the recorded condition is resolved: "
                                   + str(progress_path))
            atomic_json(directory / "tiles.json",
                        {"plan_sha256": digest(plan), "tiles": [records[i] for i in range(len(tiles))]},
                        immutable=True)
            return publish("acquired")
        except BaseException:
            if not failures:
                publish("interrupted")
            for future in futures:
                future.cancel()
            raise
        finally:
            executor.shutdown(wait=True, cancel_futures=True)


def assemble_dem(directory, *, progress=None):
    """Assemble only retained original tiles; this phase makes no HTTP requests."""
    from model import rasters
    import numpy as np
    import rasterio
    from rasterio.windows import Window
    import time
    directory = Path(directory)
    with held(directory / "prepare.lock", blocking=False):
        plan, requests = _load_dem_plan(directory)
        complete = _dem_complete_entry(directory, plan)
        if complete is not None:
            return complete
        grid = plan["grid"]
        vintage = plan["vintage"]
        metadata_filename = plan["metadata_file"]
        tiles = [_dem_tile_record(directory, tile, grid, verify=True) for tile in requests]
        atomic_json(directory / "tiles.json",
                    {"plan_sha256": digest(plan), "tiles": tiles}, immutable=True)
        started = now()
        clock = time.monotonic()

        def emit_assembly(state, finished_tiles, valid_cells, nodata_cells, *, error=None):
            item = {"schema": "upstate.3dep-assembly/v1", "plan_sha256": digest(plan),
                    "state": state, "started_at": started, "updated_at": now(),
                    "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - clock, 6),
                    "tile_count": len(tiles), "assembled_tiles": finished_tiles,
                    "valid_cells": valid_cells, "nodata_cells": nodata_cells}
            if error is not None:
                item["error"] = error
            atomic_json(directory / "assembly-progress.json", item)
            if progress:
                progress(item)

        emit_assembly("assembling", 0, 0, 0)
        result_path = directory / "source-entry.json"
        destination = directory / "dem.tif"
        pending = directory / "dem.tif.partial"
        profile = rasters.output_profile(grid)
        valid, missing, low, high = 0, 0, None, None
        finished_tiles = 0
        try:
            with rasterio.Env(GDAL_CACHEMAX=64*1024*1024), rasterio.open(pending, "w", **profile) as out:
                for tile_index, tile in enumerate(tiles):
                    with rasterio.open(directory / tile["file"]) as original:
                        for _, window in original.block_windows(1):
                            data = original.read(1, window=window, masked=True)
                            raw = np.ma.getdata(data)
                            bad = np.ma.getmaskarray(data) | ~np.isfinite(raw)
                            values = raw.copy()
                            values[bad] = profile["nodata"]
                            good = values[~bad]
                            valid += int(good.size)
                            missing += int(bad.sum())
                            if good.size:
                                low = float(good.min()) if low is None else min(low, float(good.min()))
                                high = float(good.max()) if high is None else max(high, float(good.max()))
                            target = Window(window.col_off+tile["col"], window.row_off+tile["row"], window.width, window.height)
                            out.write(values, 1, window=target)
                    finished_tiles = tile_index + 1
                    emit_assembly("assembling", finished_tiles, valid, missing)
                out.update_tags(units="m", source=DEM_SERVICE, source_vintage=vintage,
                                rendering_rule="None", assembly="Original aligned Float32 tile values, no further resampling")
            if not valid:
                raise ValueError("The original elevation exports contain no finite numeric cells")
            with pending.open("rb") as handle:
                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
            os.replace(pending, destination)
            _fsync_directory(directory)
            companions = [describe_file(directory, directory / name)
