                          for name in ["plan.json", "tiles.json", metadata_filename]]
            for tile in tiles:
                for name in (tile["file"], tile["file"]+".capture.json"):
                    companions.append(describe_file(directory, directory / name))
            entry = {"id": "usgs-3dep-dem-" + digest(plan)[:16], "title": "USGS 3DEP original elevation mosaic",
                     "kind": "raster", "role": "DEM", "uri": DEM_SERVICE, "vintage": vintage, "units": "m",
                     "resampling": "bilinear", **describe_file(directory, destination), "companions": companions,
                     "preparation_sha256": digest(plan), "grid": grid,
                     "observed": {"valid_cells": valid, "nodata_cells": missing, "minimum_m": low, "maximum_m": high},
                     "derivation": "Provider exports on the original NLCD-aligned 30m grid; exact disjoint pixel assembly"}
            atomic_json(result_path, entry, immutable=True)
            emit_assembly("complete", len(tiles), valid, missing)
            return entry
        except BaseException as error:
            try:
                emit_assembly(
                    "interrupted" if isinstance(error, (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit)) else "failed",
                    finished_tiles, valid, missing,
                    error={"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)})
            except Exception:
                # Preserve the original failure if progress storage or its callback fails.
                pass
            raise

def prepare_dem(reference, domain, metadata_path, directory, *, vintage, layer=None,
                where=None, buffer_m=1000, tile_size=2048, workers=1, progress=None):
    """Run the original DEM intake, reusing its immutable plan and original tiles."""
    plan_dem(reference, domain, metadata_path, directory, vintage=vintage,
             layer=layer, where=where, buffer_m=buffer_m, tile_size=tile_size)
    plan, _ = _load_dem_plan(directory)
    with held(Path(directory) / "prepare.lock", blocking=False):
        complete = _dem_complete_entry(directory, plan)
    if complete is not None:
        return complete
    acquire_dem(directory, workers=workers, progress=progress)
    return assemble_dem(directory, progress=progress)


def prepare_prism(directory, *, archive_path=None, capture_path=None, transfer_path=None):
    import rasterio
    directory = Path(directory)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with held(directory / "prepare.lock"):
        source = Path(archive_path).resolve() if archive_path else directory / "prism-ppt-1991-2020-800m.zip"
        transfer_sha = None
        transfer_raw = None
        if transfer_path:
            if not archive_path or capture_path:
                raise ValueError("A received PRISM transfer requires its original archive and transfer result")
            from .source_transfer import received_transfer, capture_from_transfer
            transfer_path = Path(transfer_path).resolve(strict=True)
            transfer_raw = transfer_path.read_bytes()
            transfer_sha = hashlib.sha256(transfer_raw).hexdigest()
            transferred, original = received_transfer(
                transfer_path, source, source_url=PRISM_ANNUAL, maximum_bytes=96*1024*1024)
            receipt = capture_from_transfer(transferred, original, transfer_sha256=transfer_sha)
        elif archive_path:
            if not source.is_file():
                raise ValueError("Select the retained complete original PRISM annual archive")
            receipt_path = Path(capture_path) if capture_path else source.with_name(source.name+".capture.json")
            receipt = read_json(receipt_path)
            if (receipt.get("url") != PRISM_ANNUAL or receipt.get("status") != 200
                    or receipt.get("state") != "complete" or not _matches(source, receipt)):
                raise ValueError("PRISM archive differs from the original complete annual source receipt")
        else:
            receipt = capture(PRISM_ANNUAL, source, maximum_bytes=96*1024*1024)
        result_path = directory / "source-entry.json"
        if result_path.exists():
            entry = read_json(result_path)
            if (entry["original_archive_sha256"] != receipt["sha256"]
                    or not _matches(directory/entry["path"], entry)
                    or (transfer_sha is not None and entry.get("transfer_receipt_sha256") != transfer_sha)):
                raise ValueError("Retained precipitation source differs")
            for item in entry["companions"]:
                if not _matches(directory / item["path"], item):
                    raise ValueError("An original precipitation companion changed")
            return entry
        with zipfile.ZipFile(source) as archive:
            infos = archive.infolist()
            tiffs = [x for x in infos if x.filename.lower().endswith((".tif", ".tiff")) and not x.is_dir()]
            if len(tiffs) != 1 or len({i.filename for i in infos}) != len(infos):
                raise ValueError("Select the single-raster original annual PRISM archive")
            selected = tiffs[0]
            if selected.file_size > 512*1024*1024:
                raise ValueError("Original annual precipitation raster exceeds the declared intake")
            destination = directory / "precipitation.tif"
            pending = directory / "precipitation.tif.partial"
            with archive.open(selected) as original, pending.open("wb") as out:
                for block in iter(lambda: original.read(1024*1024), b""):
                    out.write(block)
                out.flush()
                os.fsync(out.fileno())
            os.replace(pending, destination)
            members = [{"name": info.filename, "bytes": info.file_size, "crc32": f"{info.CRC:08x}"} for info in infos]
        with rasterio.open(destination) as dataset:
            if dataset.count != 1 or not dataset.crs:
                raise ValueError("The original precipitation member lacks its native single-band grid")
            actual = {"crs": dataset.crs.to_wkt(), "transform": list(dataset.transform)[:6],
                      "width": dataset.width, "height": dataset.height, "nodata": dataset.nodata,
                      "dtype": dataset.dtypes[0], "native_tags": dataset.tags(), "resolution": list(dataset.res),
                      "band_scale": dataset.scales[0], "band_offset": dataset.offsets[0]}
            if not math.isfinite(dataset.scales[0]) or dataset.scales[0] <= 0 or dataset.offsets[0] != 0:
                raise ValueError("The original precipitation band requires a different explicit unit conversion")
        # Retain the complete original archive beside its native raster without re-encoding.
        local_archive = directory / "original/prism-ppt-1991-2020-800m.zip"
        local_archive.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        if local_archive.resolve() != source.resolve():
            from model.common import retain_file
            if not local_archive.exists():
                try:
                    os.link(source, local_archive)
                except OSError as error:
                    import errno
                    if error.errno != errno.EXDEV:
                        raise
                    original_object = retain_file(directory, source, receipt["sha256"])
                    os.link(directory / original_object["object"], local_archive)
            if not _matches(local_archive, receipt):
                raise ValueError("The retained original precipitation archive changed during handoff")
        atomic_json(directory / "original/prism.capture.json", receipt, immutable=True)
        atomic_json(directory / "original/archive-members.json", members, immutable=True)
        if transfer_raw is not None:
            from model.common import atomic_bytes
            atomic_bytes(directory / "original/source-transfer.json", transfer_raw, immutable=True)
        entry = {"id": "prism-ppt-1991-2020-800m", "title": "PRISM 1991-2020 annual precipitation normal",
                 "kind": "raster", "role": "PRECIPITATION", "uri": PRISM_ANNUAL,
                 "vintage": "1991-2020 annual precipitation climate normal",
                 "units": "mm/year", "resampling": "bilinear", **describe_file(directory, destination),
                 "original_archive_sha256": receipt["sha256"], "native_grid": actual,
                 "companions": [describe_file(directory, local_archive),
                                describe_file(directory, directory / "original/prism.capture.json"),
                                describe_file(directory, directory / "original/archive-members.json")],
                 "use": "Annual precipitation as the explicitly selected NDR runoff proxy",
                 "source_resolution": "Original 30-arcsecond (nominal 800m) grid; model alignment retains this source resolution",
                 "citation": {"publisher": "PRISM Group, Oregon State University",
                              "url": "https://prism.oregonstate.edu/", "accessed_at": receipt["observed_at"],
                              "documentation": PRISM_REFERENCE}}
        if transfer_sha is not None:
            entry["transfer_receipt_sha256"] = transfer_sha
            entry["companions"].append(describe_file(directory, directory / "original/source-transfer.json"))
        if actual["band_scale"] != 1:
            entry["conversion"] = {"factor": actual["band_scale"], "target_units": "mm/year",
                                   "reference": "Original PRISM raster band scale metadata retained in native_grid"}
        atomic_json(result_path, entry, immutable=True)
        return entry

def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    def add_plan_options(command):
        command.add_argument("--reference", required=True)
        command.add_argument("--domain", required=True)
        command.add_argument("--layer")
        command.add_argument("--where-json")
        command.add_argument("--buffer-m", type=float, default=1000)
        command.add_argument("--service-metadata", required=True)
        command.add_argument("--vintage", required=True)
        command.add_argument("--tile-size", type=int, default=2048)
        command.add_argument("--output", required=True)

    dem = sub.add_parser("dem", help="Prepare original numeric elevation from source through exact assembly")
    add_plan_options(dem)
    dem.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=1)
    plan = sub.add_parser("dem-plan", help="Save the original grid and portable tile requests")
    add_plan_options(plan)
    acquire = sub.add_parser("dem-acquire", help="Acquire or resume the retained original requests")
    acquire.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    acquire.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=1)
    assemble = sub.add_parser("dem-assemble", help="Assemble original retained tiles without network access")
    assemble.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    status = sub.add_parser("dem-status", help="Read retained tile progress and final source state")
    status.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    status.add_argument("--verify", action="store_true", help="Also inspect source hashes and TIFF grids")

    prism = sub.add_parser("prism", help="Retain the original annual 800m PRISM normal and its native raster")
    prism.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    prism.add_argument("--archive", help="Reuse the existing source ZIP with its adjacent capture receipt")
    prism.add_argument("--capture", help="Use the original archive receipt at this explicit retained path")
    prism.add_argument("--transfer", help="Receive the existing original archive through its completed SourceArtifacts result")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    def progress(item):
        import sys
        print(json.dumps(item, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)

    if args.command in ("dem", "dem-plan"):
        arguments = {"vintage": args.vintage, "layer": args.layer,
                     "where": json.loads(args.where_json) if args.where_json else None,
                     "buffer_m": args.buffer_m, "tile_size": args.tile_size}
        if args.command == "dem":
            result = prepare_dem(args.reference, args.domain, args.service_metadata, args.output,
                                 workers=args.workers, progress=progress, **arguments)
        else:
            result = plan_dem(args.reference, args.domain, args.service_metadata, args.output, **arguments)
    elif args.command == "dem-acquire":
        result = acquire_dem(args.output, workers=args.workers, progress=progress)
    elif args.command == "dem-assemble":
        result = assemble_dem(args.output, progress=progress)
    elif args.command == "dem-status":
        result = dem_status(args.output, verify=args.verify)
    else:
        result = prepare_prism(args.output, archive_path=args.archive, capture_path=args.capture,
                               transfer_path=args.transfer)
    print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Reopen original source bytes carried by the maintained SourceArtifacts helper.

The original helper owns HTTP streaming and Slack finalization. This reader
binds its completed result to the exact local file supplied to source intake.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import re
from model.common import file_digest, read_json

def _matches(path, record):
    path = Path(path)
    return (path.is_file() and path.stat().st_size == record["bytes"]
            and file_digest(path) == record["sha256"])

def received_transfer(path, artifact, *, source_url, maximum_bytes):
    value = read_json(path)
    if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get("event") == "result":
        value = value.get("result")
    if (not isinstance(value, dict)
            or value.get("schema") != "commons.source-artifact-transfer.v1"
            or value.get("phase") != "COMPLETE" or value.get("ok", True) is not True):
        raise ValueError("Select the completed original source-artifact transfer result")
    receipt, body = value.get("receipt"), value.get("body")
    if not isinstance(receipt, dict) or not isinstance(body, dict):
        raise ValueError("The original transfer lacks its completed source and upload receipt")
    source = receipt.get("source", {})
    count, sha = receipt.get("bytes"), receipt.get("sha256")
    if (not isinstance(source, dict)
            or type(count) is not int or not 0 < count <= maximum_bytes
            or not isinstance(sha, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", sha)
            or source.get("url") != source_url or source.get("bytes") != count
            or value.get("source") != source or body.get("complete") is not True
            or body.get("bytes") != count or body.get("sha256") != sha
            or not isinstance(body.get("streamed_at"), str) or not body["streamed_at"]
            or not _matches(artifact, {"bytes": count, "sha256": sha})):
        raise ValueError("The received source bytes differ from the original completed transfer")
    upload = receipt.get("upload_receipt", {})
    if (not isinstance(upload, dict) or upload.get("ok") is not True
            or type(upload.get("http_status")) is not int
            or not 200 <= upload["http_status"] < 300
            or upload.get("bytes_uploaded") != count
            or upload.get("acknowledged_bytes") not in (None, count)):
        raise ValueError("The original archive upload acknowledgment is incomplete")
    file_id = receipt.get("file_id")
    readback = receipt.get("readback", {})
    completed = receipt.get("provider_completion")
    destination = value.get("destination", {})
    provider_completed = (
        isinstance(completed, dict) and completed.get("ok") is True
        and isinstance(completed.get("files"), list)
        and any(isinstance(row, dict) and row.get("id") == file_id
                for row in completed["files"]))
    # A completed readback recovery can retain a null provider response when
    # the original finalization journal was interrupted. Keep that original
    # record unchanged; the full byte/upload/readback checks still apply.
    # An explicit unsuccessful provider response is not a recovery record.
    recovered_completion = (
        "provider_completion" in receipt and completed is None
        and isinstance(receipt.get("completed_at"), str)
        and bool(receipt["completed_at"].strip()))
    if (not isinstance(file_id, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"F[A-Z0-9]+", file_id)
            or value.get("file_id") != file_id
            or not (provider_completed or recovered_completion)
            or not isinstance(readback, dict) or not isinstance(destination, dict)
            or readback.get("ok") is not True or readback.get("file_id") != file_id
            or not isinstance(readback.get("message_ts"), str)
            or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+\.[0-9]{1,6}", readback["message_ts"])
            or any(readback.get(key) != receipt.get(key) or destination.get(key) != receipt.get(key)
                   for key in ("channel_id", "thread_ts"))):
        raise ValueError("The received source must keep its original completed file and destination")
    return value, receipt


def capture_from_transfer(value, receipt, *, transfer_sha256):
    """Project the accepted transfer into the existing public-source receipt."""
    source = receipt["source"]
    return {
        "schema": "upstate.received-public-source/v1", "state": "complete",
        "url": source["url"], "final_url": source["final_url"], "status": 200,
        "source_header_observed_at": source["observed_at"],
        "observed_at": value["body"]["streamed_at"],
        "bytes": receipt["bytes"], "sha256": receipt["sha256"],
        "headers": {name: source[key] for name, key in
                    (("Content-Type", "content_type"), ("ETag", "etag"), ("Last-Modified", "last_modified"))
                    if source.get(key) is not None},
        "capture_method": "Original SourceArtifacts HTTP-200 stream and completed file handoff",
        "transfer_operation_id": value["operation_id"],
        "transfer_file_id": receipt["file_id"],
        "transfer_receipt_sha256": transfer_sha256,
    }

"""USGS static terrain: discover → acquire/adopt → prepare → import/receive."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

from . import terrain_catalog as catalog
from . import terrain_prepare as preparation
from . import terrain_portable as portable
from .terrain_io import TerrainError, read_json


def _workspace(path, create=False):
    from model.workspace import Workspace
    return Workspace(path, create=create)


def _prepared_summary(value):
    if value.get("state") != "complete":
        return value
    entry = value["entry"]
    return {"state":value["state"], "plan_id":value["plan_id"], "manifest":value["manifest"],
            "source_entry":"source-entry-"+value["plan_id"]+".json", "source_id":entry["id"],
            "dem":{k:entry[k] for k in ("path","bytes","sha256","units","vertical_datum")},
            "observed":entry["observed"], "inspector":"prepared/"+value["plan_id"]+"/inspector/report.html",
            "reused":value.get("reused",False), "workspace_source":value.get("workspace_source")}


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--store", help="Independent retained terrain source directory")
    parser.add_argument("--debug", action="store_true")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    d = commands.add_parser("discover",help="Read complete original USGS directory listings")
    extent = d.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    extent.add_argument("--bounds",type=float,nargs=4,metavar=("WEST","SOUTH","EAST","NORTH"))
    extent.add_argument("--domain",help="Original complete model-domain vector")
    d.add_argument("--layer")
    d.add_argument("--where-json")
    d.add_argument("--buffer-m",type=float,default=1000)
    d.add_argument("--buffer-crs",default="EPSG:5070",help="Metre CRS for discovery buffer only; never the model grid")
    d.add_argument("--title",default="USGS 3DEP original static source edition")
    a = commands.add_parser("acquire",help="Download retained catalog members with prefix recovery")
    a.add_argument("catalog")
    a.add_argument("--workers",type=int,default=2)
    a = commands.add_parser("adopt",help="Receive an existing complete original or documented crop")
    for name in ("raster","metadata","origin","label"):
        a.add_argument("--"+name,required=True)
    for name in ("vintage","units","datum","unit-reference","derivation"):
        a.add_argument("--"+name)
    a.add_argument("--companion",action="append",default=[])
    p = commands.add_parser("plan",help="Freeze a source selection on the original exact 30m grid")
    origin = p.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    origin.add_argument("--grid-json")
    origin.add_argument("--reference",help="Actual original 30m numeric reference; with domain uses original grid writer")
    p.add_argument("--domain")
    p.add_argument("--layer")
    p.add_argument("--where-json")
    p.add_argument("--buffer-m",type=float,default=1000)
    p.add_argument("--source-id",action="append")
    p.add_argument("--title",default="Upper Savannah retained terrain")
    p.add_argument("--resampling",choices=("bilinear","nearest","average"),default="bilinear")
    p.add_argument("--chunk-size",type=int,default=1024)
    w = commands.add_parser("plan-workspace",help="Reuse original Workspace source views and grid writer")
    for name in ("workspace","reference-collection-id","reference-source-id","domain-collection-id","domain-source-id"):
        w.add_argument("--"+name,required=True)
    w.add_argument("--domain-layer")
    w.add_argument("--where-json")
    w.add_argument("--source-id",action="append")
    w.add_argument("--buffer-m",type=float,default=1000)
    w.add_argument("--title",default="Upper Savannah retained terrain")
    w.add_argument("--resampling",choices=("bilinear","nearest","average"),default="bilinear")
    w.add_argument("--chunk-size",type=int,default=1024)
    for action in ("prepare","resume"):
        run = commands.add_parser(action)
        run.add_argument("plan_id")
        run.add_argument("--workspace",help="Also import complete terrain into this existing native Workspace")
        run.add_argument("--progress",action="store_true",help="Emit chunk progress as JSON to stderr")
    for action in ("pause","status"):
        commands.add_parser(action).add_argument("plan_id")
    commands.add_parser("list")
    pack = commands.add_parser("pack")
    pack.add_argument("plan_id")
    pack.add_argument("--output",required=True)
    receive = commands.add_parser("receive")
    receive.add_argument("archive")
    receive.add_argument("--output",required=True)
    receive.add_argument("--sha256")
    native = commands.add_parser("import")
    native.add_argument("plan_id")
    native.add_argument("--workspace",required=True)
    native.add_argument("--create-workspace",action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        if args.command != "receive" and not args.store:
            parser.error("--store is required for this command")
        root = Path(args.store).resolve() if args.store else None
        if args.command == "discover":
            bounds, reference = args.bounds, None
            if args.domain:
                import math
                from pyproj import CRS,Transformer
                from shapely.ops import transform
                from .terrain_io import file_sha
                crs = CRS.from_user_input(args.buffer_crs)
                if (not crs.is_projected or any(abs(axis.unit_conversion_factor-1)>1e-12 for axis in crs.axis_info[:2])
                        or not math.isfinite(args.buffer_m) or args.buffer_m < 0):
                    raise TerrainError("Discovery needs a projected metre buffer CRS and nonnegative buffer")
                domain, metadata = preparation.read_geometry(args.domain,crs,layer=args.layer,
                                                             where=read_json(args.where_json) if args.where_json else None)
                projected = domain.buffer(args.buffer_m)
                geographic = transform(Transformer.from_crs(crs,"EPSG:4326",always_xy=True).transform,projected)
                bounds = list(geographic.bounds)
                reference = {"domain_sha256":file_sha(args.domain),"features":metadata["features"],
                             "layer":args.layer,"where":read_json(args.where_json) if args.where_json else None,
                             "buffer_m":args.buffer_m,"buffer_crs":crs.to_wkt()}
            result = catalog.discover(root,bounds,title=args.title,source_reference=reference)
            result = {key:result[key] for key in ("id","catalog_path","bounds_wgs84","tiles")}
        elif args.command == "acquire":
            result = catalog.acquire(root,args.catalog,workers=args.workers)
        elif args.command == "adopt":
            value = catalog.adopt(root,args.raster,args.metadata,origin=args.origin,label=args.label,
                                  vintage=args.vintage,units=args.units,datum=args.datum,unit_reference=args.unit_reference,
                                  companions=args.companion,derivation=read_json(args.derivation) if args.derivation else None)
            result = {key:value[key] for key in ("id","uri","vintage","raster","files","vertical_units","vertical_datum")}
        elif args.command == "plan":
            where = read_json(args.where_json) if args.where_json else None
            if args.grid_json:
                grid = read_json(args.grid_json)
                grid = grid.get("grid",grid)
            elif args.domain:
                from .raster_sources import source_grid
                grid = source_grid(args.reference,args.domain,layer=args.layer,where=where,buffer_m=args.buffer_m)
            else:
                grid = preparation.reference_grid(args.reference)
            value = preparation.plan(root,grid,source_ids=args.source_id,title=args.title,
                                     domain_path=args.domain,domain_layer=args.layer,domain_where=where,
                                     reference_path=args.reference,resampling=args.resampling,chunk_size=args.chunk_size)
            result = {"plan_id":value["id"],"grid":value["grid"],"source_ids":value["source_ids"],
                      "domain_features":value["domain"]["features"] if value["domain"] else None}
        elif args.command == "plan-workspace":
            from .terrain_workspace import plan_from_workspace
            value = plan_from_workspace(root,_workspace(args.workspace),reference_collection_id=args.reference_collection_id,
                    reference_source_id=args.reference_source_id,domain_collection_id=args.domain_collection_id,
                    domain_source_id=args.domain_source_id,domain_layer=args.domain_layer,
                    domain_where=read_json(args.where_json) if args.where_json else None,source_ids=args.source_id,
                    title=args.title,buffer_m=args.buffer_m,resampling=args.resampling,chunk_size=args.chunk_size)
            result = {"plan_id":value["id"],"grid":value["grid"],"source_ids":value["source_ids"]}
        elif args.command in ("prepare","resume"):
            if args.command == "resume":
                preparation.pause(root,args.plan_id,resume=True)
            callback = (lambda state: print(json.dumps(state,sort_keys=True),file=sys.stderr,flush=True)) if args.progress else None
            if args.workspace:
                from .terrain_workspace import prepare_and_import
                value = prepare_and_import(root,args.plan_id,_workspace(args.workspace),progress=callback)
            else:
                value = preparation.prepare(root,args.plan_id,progress=callback)
            result = _prepared_summary(value)
        elif args.command == "pause":
            result = preparation.pause(root,args.plan_id)
        elif args.command == "status":
            selection = preparation._plan(root,args.plan_id)
            path = root/"jobs"/("prepare-"+args.plan_id+".json")
            result = read_json(path) if path.exists() else {"plan_id":args.plan_id,"state":"planned"}
            result = {**result,"title":selection["title"],"source_count":len(selection["source_ids"]),
                      "pause_requested":(root/"jobs"/("prepare-"+args.plan_id+".pause.json")).exists()}
            # Portable receiving omits transient jobs but retains completed outputs.
            if (root/("source-entry-"+args.plan_id+".json")).exists():
                result.update(state="complete",manifest="sources-"+args.plan_id+".json")
        elif args.command == "list":
            result = {"sources":[{key:item[key] for key in ("id","label","vintage","vertical_units","vertical_datum")}
                                 for item in catalog.sources(root,check=False)],
                      "plans":[{"plan_id":path.stem,"title":read_json(path)["title"]}
                               for path in sorted((root/"plans").glob("*.json"))]}
        elif args.command == "pack":
            result = portable.pack(root,args.plan_id,args.output)
        elif args.command == "receive":
            result = portable.receive(args.archive,args.output,expected_sha256=args.sha256)
        elif args.command == "import":
            from .terrain_workspace import import_into_workspace
            result = import_into_workspace(root,args.plan_id,_workspace(args.workspace,args.create_workspace))
        print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True,indent=2,allow_nan=False))
        return 0
    except Exception as error:
        if args.debug:
            raise
        print(json.dumps({"state":"error","type":type(error).__name__,"message":str(error)},sort_keys=True),file=sys.stderr)
        return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Complete terrain data packets: retained originals, outputs and editable plan."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import stat
import tempfile
import zipfile

from .terrain_io import (TerrainError, atomic_json, canonical, describe, file_sha,
                         identity, read_json, relative_path, sync_directory, verify, publish_directory)
from .terrain_prepare import _plan

HEADER = "terrain-package.json"
SCHEMA = "upstate.terrain-package/v1"


def packet_members(root, plan_id):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    _plan(root, plan_id)
    manifest = root/("sources-"+plan_id+".json")
    selected = read_json(manifest)
    if selected.get("schema") != "upstate.sources/v1" or len(selected.get("entries", [])) != 1:
        raise TerrainError("Select a completed terrain source manifest")
    entry = selected["entries"][0]
    if entry.get("preparation_sha256") != plan_id:
        raise TerrainError("Source manifest belongs to a different terrain plan")
    result = {manifest.name: describe(root, manifest)}
    for member in [entry] + entry["companions"]:
        path = verify(root, member)
        value = describe(root, path)
        if value["path"] in result and result[value["path"]] != value:
            raise TerrainError("Conflicting terrain packet members")
        result[value["path"]] = value
    return sorted(result.values(), key=lambda item: item["path"])


def pack(root, plan_id, destination):
    """Write a create-only ZIP64 packet; transient chunks/caches are unnecessary."""
    root, destination = Path(root).resolve(), Path(destination).absolute()
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if destination.exists():
        raise TerrainError("Choose a new terrain packet filename")
    members = packet_members(root, plan_id)
    total = sum(member["bytes"] for member in members)
    if shutil.disk_usage(destination.parent).free < total + 16*1024*1024:
        raise OSError("Insufficient output space for a complete terrain packet")
    header = {"schema": SCHEMA, "plan_id":plan_id, "files":members,
              "source_manifest":"sources-"+plan_id+".json",
              "source_entry":"source-entry-"+plan_id+".json",
              "complete_originals":True,
              "receiving":"Create a separate independently editable terrain store; reuse original Workspace.import_sources"}
    header["content_sha256"] = identity(header)
    fd, name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".terrain-packet-", suffix=".zip", dir=destination.parent)
    os.close(fd)
    pending = Path(name)
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(pending, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6,
                             allowZip64=True, strict_timestamps=False) as archive:
            archive.writestr(HEADER, canonical(header))
            for member in members:
                source = verify(root, member)
                # Stream from the retained source; do not hold national rasters in RAM.
                info = zipfile.ZipInfo(member["path"], date_time=(1980,1,1,0,0,0))
                info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
                info.external_attr = 0o100644 << 16
                h, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
                with source.open("rb") as stream, archive.open(info, "w", force_zip64=True) as out:
                    for block in iter(lambda:stream.read(1024*1024), b""):
                        out.write(block)
                        h.update(block)
                        count += len(block)
                if count != member["bytes"] or h.hexdigest() != member["sha256"]:
                    raise TerrainError("Original source changed during packet writing: "+member["path"])
        with pending.open("rb") as stream:
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.link(pending, destination)
        sync_directory(destination.parent)
    finally:
        pending.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return {"packet":str(destination), "bytes":destination.stat().st_size, "sha256":file_sha(destination),
            "content_sha256":header["content_sha256"], "plan_id":plan_id,
            "files":len(members), "uncompressed_bytes":total}


def _checked_header(archive):
    infos = archive.infolist()
    if len({item.filename for item in infos}) != len(infos):
        raise TerrainError("Duplicate terrain archive members")
    by_name = {item.filename:item for item in infos}
    if HEADER not in by_name or by_name[HEADER].file_size > 16*1024*1024:
        raise TerrainError("Missing or oversized terrain package descriptor")
    header = json.loads(archive.read(HEADER))
    expected = header.pop("content_sha256", None)
    if header.get("schema") != SCHEMA or identity(header) != expected:
        raise TerrainError("Terrain package descriptor differs")
    header["content_sha256"] = expected
    if not isinstance(header.get("files"), list) or not header["files"]:
        raise TerrainError("Terrain package has no original files")
    names = {item["path"] for item in header["files"]}
    if len(names) != len(header["files"]) or names | {HEADER} != set(by_name):
        raise TerrainError("Terrain archive and its complete file inventory disagree")
    if header.get("source_manifest") not in names or header.get("source_entry") not in names:
        raise TerrainError("Terrain package lacks its native source manifest or entry")
    for record in header["files"]:
        info = by_name[record["path"]]
        mode = info.external_attr >> 16
        if (info.is_dir() or stat.S_ISLNK(mode) or (mode and stat.S_IFMT(mode) not in (0,stat.S_IFREG))
                or info.flag_bits & 1 or info.compress_type not in (zipfile.ZIP_STORED,zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)):
            raise TerrainError("Unsupported terrain package member type")
        if (isinstance(record["bytes"],bool) or not isinstance(record["bytes"],int) or record["bytes"] < 0
                or info.file_size != record["bytes"]):
            raise TerrainError("Terrain package member length disagrees")
        digest = record["sha256"]
        if len(digest) != 64 or any(char not in "0123456789abcdef" for char in digest):
            raise TerrainError("Invalid terrain package member hash")
    return header


def receive(archive_path, destination, *, expected_sha256=None):
    """Verify every retained byte and publish a complete create-only receiving."""
    archive_path, destination = Path(archive_path).resolve(strict=True), Path(destination).absolute()
    if expected_sha256 and file_sha(archive_path) != expected_sha256:
        raise TerrainError("Terrain packet differs from the sender's selected SHA-256")
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if destination.exists():
        raise TerrainError("Receive a terrain project into a new directory")
    staging = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".terrain-receive-", dir=destination.parent))
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
            header = _checked_header(archive)
            # Validate all paths before extracting any original body.
            for record in header["files"]:
                relative_path(staging, record["path"], exists=False)
            total = sum(record["bytes"] for record in header["files"])
            if shutil.disk_usage(staging).free < total + 16*1024*1024:
                raise OSError("Insufficient space to receive every original terrain file")
            for record in header["files"]:
                target = relative_path(staging, record["path"], exists=False)
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                h, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
                with archive.open(record["path"]) as src, target.open("xb") as out:
                    for block in iter(lambda:src.read(1024*1024),b""):
                        count += len(block)
                        if count > record["bytes"]:
                            raise TerrainError("Terrain archive member exceeds its declared length")
                        out.write(block)
                        h.update(block)
                    out.flush()
                    os.fsync(out.fileno())
                if count != record["bytes"] or h.hexdigest() != record["sha256"]:
                    raise TerrainError("Terrain archive member differs: "+record["path"])
        # Validate the original plan and complete manifest relationships before publication.
        _plan(staging, header["plan_id"])
        actual_members = packet_members(staging, header["plan_id"])
        if actual_members != header["files"]:
            raise TerrainError("Received source manifest differs from the sender's file closure")
        atomic_json(staging/HEADER,header,immutable=True)
        publish_directory(staging,destination)
        return {"state":"received", "directory":str(destination), "plan_id":header["plan_id"],
                "manifest":str(destination/header["source_manifest"]), "files":len(actual_members),
                "uncompressed_bytes":total, "content_sha256":header["content_sha256"]}
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(staging,ignore_errors=True)

"""Disk-backed native mosaics and restartable 30 m terrain preparation.

Original tiles are mosaicked in their shared native lattice before a single
horizontal reprojection. No depression filling, hydrologic conditioning, vertical
datum transformation, invented elevations or polygon-edge zero fill is applied.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import gzip
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
from typing import Any, Callable

from .terrain_catalog import inspect_raster, sources
from .terrain_io import (TerrainError, atomic_json, copy_original, describe, file_sha,
                         identity, locked, now, read_json, relative_path,
                         sync_directory, verify)

NODATA = -3.4028234663852886e38


def validate_grid(value: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    from pyproj import CRS
    from affine import Affine
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise TerrainError("Select the original 30 m grid definition")
    crs = CRS.from_user_input(value["crs"])
    transform = list(value["transform"])
    width, height = value["width"], value["height"]
    if (len(transform) != 6 or not all(math.isfinite(float(x)) for x in transform)
            or isinstance(width, bool) or isinstance(height, bool)
            or int(width) != width or int(height) != height or width <= 0 or height <= 0):
        raise TerrainError("Invalid finite terrain grid dimensions or transform")
    if (not crs.is_projected or len(crs.axis_info) < 2
            or any(abs(float(axis.unit_conversion_factor)-1) > 1e-12 for axis in crs.axis_info[:2])):
        raise TerrainError("The target terrain grid must be projected in metres")
    a, b, c, d, e, f = map(float, transform)
    if b != 0 or d != 0 or abs(a-30) > 1e-9 or abs(e+30) > 1e-9:
        raise TerrainError("The model terrain grid must use unrotated, square, exact 30 m cells")
    from rasterio.transform import array_bounds
    transform = Affine(30, 0, c, 0, -30, f)
    return {"crs": crs.to_wkt(), "crs_name": crs.to_string(),
            "transform": list(transform)[:6], "width": int(width), "height": int(height),
            "resolution_m": 30.0, "pixel_area_ha": 0.09,
            "bounds": list(array_bounds(int(height), int(width), transform))}


def reference_grid(path: Path | str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    import rasterio
    with rasterio.open(path) as source:
        grid = {"crs": source.crs.to_wkt() if source.crs else None,
                "transform": list(source.transform)[:6],
                "width": source.width, "height": source.height}
    return validate_grid(grid)


def read_geometry(path: Path | str, target_crs, *, layer=None, where=None):
    """Read all selected original polygons, without simplification or silent repair."""
    import fiona
    from pyproj import CRS, Transformer
    from shapely.geometry import shape, mapping
    from shapely.ops import transform, unary_union
    path = Path(path).resolve(strict=True)
    with path.open("rb") as original:
        compressed = original.read(2) == b"\x1f\x8b"
    native_path = "/vsigzip/"+path.as_posix() if compressed else str(path)
    parameters = {}
    fiona_root = Path(fiona.__file__).parent
    for key, folder in (("GDAL_DATA", "gdal_data"), ("PROJ_DATA", "proj_data"), ("PROJ_LIB", "proj_data")):
        if (fiona_root / folder).is_dir():
            parameters[key] = str(fiona_root / folder)
    geometries = []
    with fiona.Env(**parameters), fiona.open(native_path, layer=layer) as source:
        origin = CRS.from_user_input(source.crs_wkt or source.crs)
        transformer = Transformer.from_crs(origin, target_crs, always_xy=True)
        for feature in source:
            if where and any(str(feature["properties"].get(key)) != str(value) for key, value in where.items()):
                continue
            if feature["geometry"] is None:
                raise TerrainError("Selected model-domain feature has no geometry")
            polygon = shape(feature["geometry"])
            if polygon.geom_type not in ("Polygon", "MultiPolygon") or polygon.is_empty or not polygon.is_valid:
                raise TerrainError("Selected model-domain geometry is not a valid original polygon")
            projected = transform(transformer.transform, polygon)
            if projected.is_empty or not projected.is_valid or not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in projected.bounds):
                raise TerrainError("Model-domain transformation produced invalid coordinates")
            geometries.append(projected)
    if not geometries:
        raise TerrainError("The model-domain selection contains no polygons")
    combined = unary_union(geometries)
    if not combined.is_valid:
        raise TerrainError("The original selected-domain union is invalid")
    return combined, {"features": len(geometries), "original_crs": origin.to_wkt(),
                      "target_crs": CRS.from_user_input(target_crs).to_wkt(),
                      "area_ha": float(combined.area/10000), "geometry": mapping(combined)}


def plan(root: Path | str, grid: dict[str, Any], *, source_ids: list[str] | None = None,
         title: str = "Upper Savannah retained terrain", domain_path: Path | str | None = None,
         domain_layer: str | None = None, domain_where: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
         reference_path: Path | str | None = None, source_reference: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
         resampling: str = "bilinear", chunk_size: int = 1024) -> dict[str, Any]:
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    checked = validate_grid(grid)
    selected = sources(root, source_ids)
    if not selected:
        raise TerrainError("Retain at least one complete numeric DEM source first")
    if resampling not in ("bilinear", "nearest", "average"):
        raise TerrainError("Choose bilinear, nearest or average elevation resampling")
    if not isinstance(chunk_size, int) or not 64 <= chunk_size <= 4096:
        raise TerrainError("Choose a processing chunk width between 64 and 4096 cells")
    domain = None
    selection_files = []
    if domain_path:
        domain_path = Path(domain_path).resolve(strict=True)
        geometry, metadata = read_geometry(domain_path, checked["crs"], layer=domain_layer, where=domain_where)
        from shapely.geometry import box
        if not geometry.intersects(box(*checked["bounds"])):
            raise TerrainError("The selected model domain does not intersect this grid")
        folder = root / "selections" / file_sha(domain_path)
        copy_original(domain_path, folder / domain_path.name)
        original_files = [describe(root, folder / domain_path.name)]
        if domain_path.suffix.lower() == ".shp":
            for extension in (".shx", ".dbf", ".prj", ".cpg"):
                companion = domain_path.with_suffix(extension)
                if companion.exists():
                    copy_original(companion, folder / companion.name)
                    original_files.append(describe(root, folder / companion.name))
        outside = geometry.difference(box(*checked["bounds"]))
        domain = {**metadata, "layer": domain_layer, "where": domain_where, "files": original_files,
                  "outside_grid_area_ha": float(outside.area/10000),
                  "inside_grid_area_ha": float(geometry.intersection(box(*checked["bounds"])).area/10000),
                  "contained_by_grid": outside.is_empty or outside.area < 1e-7,
                  "coverage_rule": "Unique selected-domain pixel centres, without clipping the computational DEM"}
        selection_files += original_files
    if reference_path:
        reference_path = Path(reference_path).resolve(strict=True)
        # Preserve source identity without duplicating a multi-gigabyte NLCD raster.
        # The exact independent grid definition is sufficient for terrain replay.
        reference = {"sha256": file_sha(reference_path), "bytes": reference_path.stat().st_size,
                     "filename": reference_path.name, "grid_definition": checked}
    else:
        reference = {"grid_definition": checked}
    value = {"schema": "upstate.terrain-plan/v1", "title": title,
             "source_ids": [source["id"] for source in selected],
             "source_records": [describe(root, root/"sources"/(source["id"]+".json")) for source in selected],
             "grid": checked, "reference": reference, "source_reference": source_reference,
             "domain": domain, "selection_files": selection_files,
             "resampling": resampling, "chunk_size": chunk_size,
             "native_overlap": "First valid original sample in declared source order; no blending",
             "vertical_operation": "Original scale and offset, then declared unit conversion to metres; no datum shift",
             "hydrologic_conditioning": "None; the original InVEST engine retains its preprocessing",
             "output_dtype": "float32", "output_nodata": NODATA}
    key = identity(value)
    atomic_json(root/"plans"/(key+".json"), value, immutable=True)
    return {**value, "id": key}


def profile(grid: dict[str, Any], **changes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    from affine import Affine
    return {"driver": "GTiff", "width": grid["width"], "height": grid["height"],
            "count": 1, "dtype": "float32", "crs": grid["crs"],
            "transform": Affine(*grid["transform"]), "nodata": NODATA,
            "tiled": True, "blockxsize": 256, "blockysize": 256,
            "compress": "deflate", "predictor": 3, "BIGTIFF": "IF_SAFER", **changes}


def _publish_raster(pending: Path, path: Path) -> None:
    with pending.open("rb") as stream:
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    os.replace(pending, path)
    sync_directory(path.parent)


def native_mosaic(root: Path, selected: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    import numpy as np
    import rasterio
    from affine import Affine
    from rasterio.merge import merge
    from rasterio.crs import CRS
    from .terrain_catalog import datum_key
    datums = {datum_key(source["vertical_datum"]) for source in selected}
    if len(datums) != 1:
        raise TerrainError("One native terrain mosaic must use a common declared vertical datum")
    selection = {"schema": "upstate.terrain-native-mosaic/v1", "sources": [x["id"] for x in selected],
                 "overlap": "first valid", "dtype": "float32", "units": "m", "nodata": NODATA}
    key = identity(selection)
    folder = root / "mosaics" / key
    record_path = folder / "mosaic.json"
    with locked(folder/"mosaic.lock"):
        if record_path.exists():
            record = read_json(record_path)
            if record["selection"] != selection:
                raise TerrainError("Retained native mosaic belongs to different sources")
            verify(root, record["file"])
            return record
        paths = []
        native = None
        for source in selected:
            original = verify(root, source["files"][0])
            with rasterio.open(original) as dataset:
                actual = (dataset.crs, dataset.transform.a, dataset.transform.e,
                          dataset.transform.c, dataset.transform.f)
                if native is None:
                    native = actual
                else:
                    same_crs = dataset.crs == native[0]
                    same_res = (math.isclose(actual[1], native[1], rel_tol=1e-10, abs_tol=1e-12)
                                and math.isclose(actual[2], native[2], rel_tol=1e-10, abs_tol=1e-12))
                    same_lattice = (abs((actual[3]-native[3])/native[1]-round((actual[3]-native[3])/native[1])) < 1e-5
                                    and abs((actual[4]-native[4])/native[2]-round((actual[4]-native[4])/native[2])) < 1e-5)
                    if not (same_crs and same_res and same_lattice):
                        raise TerrainError("Selected DEMs do not share one native CRS/resolution/lattice; select a homogeneous edition")
                factor, scale, offset = source["vertical_factor_to_m"], dataset.scales[0], dataset.offsets[0]
                # Normalize masks as well as numeric units, so unlabelled NaN samples
                # do not defeat first-valid overlap selection. Originals remain unchanged.
                needs_normalization = True
                if needs_normalization:
                    normalized = folder / (source["id"]+"-metres.tif")
                    pending = normalized.with_suffix(".tif.partial")
                    kwargs = dataset.profile.copy()
                    kwargs.update(driver="GTiff", dtype="float32", nodata=NODATA, count=1,
                                  tiled=True, blockxsize=256, blockysize=256,
                                  compress="deflate", predictor=3, BIGTIFF="IF_SAFER")
                    with rasterio.open(pending, "w", **kwargs) as out:
                        for _, window in dataset.block_windows(1):
                            data = dataset.read(1, window=window, masked=True)
                            raw = np.ma.getdata(data)
                            bad = np.ma.getmaskarray(data) | ~np.isfinite(raw)
                            converted = (raw.astype("float64")*scale+offset)*factor
                            if not np.isfinite(converted[~bad]).all() or np.any(np.abs(converted[~bad]) >= abs(NODATA)):
                                raise TerrainError("Source elevation normalization overflowed Float32")
                            converted[bad] = NODATA
                            out.write(converted.astype("float32"), 1, window=window)
                        out.update_tags(units="m", vertical_datum=source["vertical_datum"],
                                        source_id=source["id"], conversion="(raw*scale+offset)*unit_factor")
                        out.set_band_unit(1, "m")
                    _publish_raster(pending, normalized)
                    paths.append(normalized)
                else:
                    paths.append(original)
        destination = folder / "mosaic.tif"
        pending = folder / "mosaic.tif.partial"
        with rasterio.Env(GDAL_CACHEMAX=64*1024*1024):
            merge(paths, dst_path=pending, dtype="float32", nodata=np.float32(NODATA),
                  res=(native[1], -native[2]), method="first", mem_limit=64,
                  dst_kwds={"tiled": True, "blockxsize": 256, "blockysize": 256,
                            "compress": "deflate", "predictor": 3, "BIGTIFF": "IF_SAFER"})
        with rasterio.open(pending, "r+") as out:
            out.update_tags(units="m", vertical_datum=selected[0]["vertical_datum"],
                            source_order=",".join(source["id"] for source in selected),
                            overlap_resolution="first valid original sample", hydrologic_conditioning="none")
            out.set_band_unit(1, "m")
        _publish_raster(pending, destination)
        record = {"selection": selection, "id": key, "file": describe(root, destination),
                  "native_grid": inspect_raster(destination, scan=False),
                  "vertical_datum": selected[0]["vertical_datum"]}
        atomic_json(record_path, record, immutable=True)
        return record


def _statistics(data, bad, domain):
    import numpy as np
    def measure(mask):
        values = data[mask & ~bad].astype("float64")
        return {"cells": int(mask.sum()), "valid": int(values.size),
                "missing": int(np.count_nonzero(mask & bad)),
                "sum": float(values.sum(dtype="float64")),
                "sum_squares": float(np.square(values).sum(dtype="float64")),
                "minimum_m": float(values.min()) if values.size else None,
                "maximum_m": float(values.max()) if values.size else None}
    return {"grid": measure(np.ones(data.shape, dtype="bool")), "domain": measure(domain)}


def _combine_statistics(records):
    output = {}
    for kind in ("grid", "domain"):
        values = [record["statistics"][kind] for record in records]
        count = sum(x["valid"] for x in values)
        total_cells = sum(x["cells"] for x in values)
        total = sum(x["sum"] for x in values)
        squares = sum(x["sum_squares"] for x in values)
        lows = [x["minimum_m"] for x in values if x["minimum_m"] is not None]
        highs = [x["maximum_m"] for x in values if x["maximum_m"] is not None]
        output[kind] = {"cells": total_cells, "valid_cells": count,
                        "nodata_cells": sum(x["missing"] for x in values),
                        "valid_fraction": count/total_cells if total_cells else None,
                        "pixel_area_ha": 0.09, "valid_area_ha": count*0.09,
                        "minimum_m": min(lows) if lows else None, "maximum_m": max(highs) if highs else None,
                        "mean_m": total/count if count else None,
                        "standard_deviation_m": math.sqrt(max(0, squares/count-(total/count)**2)) if count else None}
    return output


def _plan(root: Path, key: str):
    if not isinstance(key, str) or len(key) != 64 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in key):
        raise TerrainError("Select an existing retained terrain plan ID")
    value = read_json(root/"plans"/(key+".json"))
    if identity(value) != key or value.get("schema") != "upstate.terrain-plan/v1":
        raise TerrainError("Retained terrain plan changed")
    for record in value["source_records"] + value["selection_files"]:
        verify(root, record)
    return value


def prepare(root: Path | str, plan_id: str, *, progress: Callable[[dict], None] | None = None,
            stop_after_chunks: int | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    import numpy as np
    import rasterio
    from affine import Affine
    from rasterio.enums import Resampling
    from rasterio.features import geometry_mask
    from rasterio.vrt import WarpedVRT
    from rasterio.windows import Window
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    selection = _plan(root, plan_id)
    selected = sources(root, selection["source_ids"])
    grid = selection["grid"]
    folder = root / "prepared" / plan_id
    job = root / "jobs" / ("prepare-"+plan_id+".json")
    pause = root / "jobs" / ("prepare-"+plan_id+".pause.json")
    entry_path = root / ("source-entry-"+plan_id+".json")
    source_manifest = root / ("sources-"+plan_id+".json")
    with locked(folder/"prepare.lock"):
        if entry_path.exists():
            entry = read_json(entry_path)
            if entry["preparation_sha256"] != plan_id:
                raise TerrainError("Prepared terrain belongs to another plan")
            for member in [entry]+entry["companions"]:
                verify(root, member)
            # A receiver may have died between entry creation and manifest creation.
            _source_manifest(root, selection, entry, entry_path, source_manifest)
            return {"state": "complete", "plan_id": plan_id, "entry": entry,
                    "manifest": source_manifest.relative_to(root).as_posix(), "reused": True}
        state = {"schema": "upstate.terrain-preparation/v1", "plan_id": plan_id,
                 "state": "preparing_native_mosaic", "updated_at": now(), "completed_chunks": 0}
        atomic_json(job, state)
        try:
            native = native_mosaic(root, selected)
            source = verify(root, native["file"])
            state.update(state="reprojecting", native_mosaic=native["id"], updated_at=now())
            atomic_json(job, state)
            chunks = []
            chunk_size = selection["chunk_size"]
            windows = [Window(col, row, min(chunk_size, grid["width"]-col), min(chunk_size, grid["height"]-row))
                       for row in range(0, grid["height"], chunk_size)
                       for col in range(0, grid["width"], chunk_size)]
            state["total_chunks"] = len(windows)
            transform = Affine(*grid["transform"])
            domain_geometry = selection["domain"]["geometry"] if selection["domain"] else None
            state["coverage_selection"] = "selected polygon centres" if domain_geometry else "whole target grid"
            completed_now = 0
            with rasterio.Env(GDAL_CACHEMAX=64*1024*1024), rasterio.open(source) as original, WarpedVRT(
                    original, crs=grid["crs"], transform=transform, width=grid["width"], height=grid["height"],
                    src_nodata=NODATA, nodata=NODATA, dtype="float32", warp_mem_limit=64,
                    resampling=getattr(Resampling, selection["resampling"])) as vrt:
                for window in windows:
                    if pause.exists():
                        state.update(state="paused", updated_at=now())
                        atomic_json(job, state)
                        return state
                    name = f"r{int(window.row_off):07d}-c{int(window.col_off):07d}"
                    path = folder / "chunks" / (name+".tif")
                    record_path = folder / "chunks" / (name+".json")
                    if record_path.exists():
                        record = read_json(record_path)
                        if record["plan_id"] != plan_id or record["window"] != list(window.flatten()):
                            raise TerrainError("Retained preparation chunk belongs to another selection")
                        verify(root, record["file"])
                    else:
                        data = vrt.read(1, window=window, masked=True)
                        values = np.ma.getdata(data).copy()
                        bad = np.ma.getmaskarray(data) | ~np.isfinite(values) | (values == NODATA)
                        values[bad] = NODATA
                        subset_transform = transform * Affine.translation(window.col_off, window.row_off)
                        domain = (geometry_mask([domain_geometry], out_shape=values.shape,
                                                transform=subset_transform, invert=True, all_touched=False)
                                  if domain_geometry else np.ones(values.shape, dtype="bool"))
                        record = {"plan_id": plan_id, "window": list(window.flatten()),
                                  "statistics": _statistics(values, bad, domain)}
                        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                        pending = path.with_suffix(".tif.partial")
                        with rasterio.open(pending, "w", **profile(grid, width=int(window.width), height=int(window.height),
                                                                  transform=subset_transform)) as out:
                            out.write(values.astype("float32"), 1)
                        _publish_raster(pending, path)
                        record["file"] = describe(root, path)
                        atomic_json(record_path, record, immutable=True)
                        completed_now += 1
                    chunks.append(record)
                    state.update(completed_chunks=len(chunks), updated_at=now())
                    atomic_json(job, state)
                    if progress:
                        progress(dict(state))
                    if stop_after_chunks is not None and completed_now >= stop_after_chunks:
                        raise InterruptedError("Requested interruption after completed terrain chunks")
            state.update(state="assembling", updated_at=now())
            atomic_json(job, state)
            destination = folder / "dem.tif"
            pending = folder / "dem.tif.partial"
            with rasterio.open(pending, "w", **profile(grid)) as out:
                for record in chunks:
                    window = Window(*record["window"])
                    with rasterio.open(verify(root, record["file"])) as chunk:
                        out.write(chunk.read(1), 1, window=window)
                out.update_tags(units="m", vertical_datum=native["vertical_datum"],
                                plan_sha256=plan_id, horizontal_resampling=selection["resampling"],
                                source="USGS 3DEP retained static elevation",
                                hydrologic_conditioning="none", vertical_datum_transformation="none")
                out.set_band_unit(1, "m")
            _publish_raster(pending, destination)
            stats = _combine_statistics(chunks)
            coverage = {"schema": "upstate.terrain-coverage/v1", "plan_id": plan_id,
                        "grid": grid, "statistics": stats,
                        "selected_domain": selection["domain"] is not None,
                        "domain_within_grid": selection["domain"]["contained_by_grid"] if selection["domain"] else True,
                        "outside_grid_area_ha": selection["domain"]["outside_grid_area_ha"] if selection["domain"] else 0.0,
                        "domain_complete": (stats["domain"]["nodata_cells"] == 0 and stats["domain"]["cells"] > 0
                                            and (not selection["domain"] or selection["domain"]["contained_by_grid"])),
                        "method": "All target cells inspected; polygon coverage uses unique pixel centres",
                        "domain_area_rule": "Pixel-centre coverage is distinct from exact vector area",
                        "vertical_datum": native["vertical_datum"]}
            coverage_path = folder / "coverage.json"
            atomic_json(coverage_path, coverage, immutable=True)
            companions = list(selection["source_records"]) + list(selection["selection_files"])
            companions += [describe(root, root/"plans"/(plan_id+".json")), describe(root, coverage_path)]
            for record in selected:
                companions += record["files"]
            unique = {item["path"]: item for item in companions}
            entry = {"id": "usgs-3dep-static-dem-"+plan_id[:20], "title": selection["title"],
                     "kind": "raster", "role": "DEM", "uri": "https://www.usgs.gov/3d-elevation-program",
                     "vintage": "; ".join(sorted({str(item["vintage"]) for item in selected})),
                     "units": "m", "vertical_datum": native["vertical_datum"], "resampling": selection["resampling"],
                     **describe(root, destination), "companions": list(unique.values()),
                     "preparation_sha256": plan_id, "grid": grid,
                     "observed": {"valid_cells": stats["grid"]["valid_cells"],
                                  "nodata_cells": stats["grid"]["nodata_cells"],
                                  "minimum_m": stats["grid"]["minimum_m"], "maximum_m": stats["grid"]["maximum_m"],
                                  "domain": stats["domain"], "domain_complete": coverage["domain_complete"]},
                     "derivation": "Native-lattice first-valid mosaic; one horizontal reprojection to the frozen 30m grid",
                     "source_ids": selection["source_ids"], "hydrologic_conditioning": "none"}
            from .terrain_report import write_report
            report_files = write_report(root, selection, plan_id, entry, coverage, selected)
            entry["companions"] += [describe(root, path) for path in report_files]
            atomic_json(entry_path, entry, immutable=True)
            _source_manifest(root, selection, entry, entry_path, source_manifest)
            state.update(state="complete", updated_at=now(), source_entry=entry_path.name,
                         manifest=source_manifest.name, observed=entry["observed"])
            atomic_json(job, state)
            return {"state": "complete", "plan_id": plan_id, "entry": entry,
                    "manifest": source_manifest.name, "reused": False}
        except BaseException as error:
            state.update(state="interrupted", updated_at=now(), error=type(error).__name__+": "+str(error))
            atomic_json(job, state)
            raise


def _source_manifest(root, selection, entry, entry_path, target):
    imported_entry = {**entry, "companions": entry["companions"]+[describe(root, entry_path)]}
    value = {"schema": "upstate.sources/v1", "title": selection["title"], "captured_at": None,
             "entries": [imported_entry],
             "scope": {"terrain_plan": entry["preparation_sha256"], "source_reference": selection["source_reference"]},
             "notes": ["Original DEMs and XML are retained as companions, with full target-grid coverage.",
                       "No hydrologic conditioning or vertical datum transformation was performed.",
                       "The existing Workspace.import_sources consumes this manifest without a replacement writer."]}
    atomic_json(target, value, immutable=True)


def pause(root: Path | str, plan_id: str, *, resume: bool = False):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    _plan(root, plan_id)
    path = root/"jobs"/("prepare-"+plan_id+".pause.json")
    if resume:
        path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    else:
        atomic_json(path, {"plan_id": plan_id, "requested_at": now()})
    return {"plan_id": plan_id, "pause_requested": not resume}

"""Additive bindings to the original Upper Savannah scientific Workspace."""
from __future__ import annotations
from pathlib import Path
from .terrain_io import TerrainError, describe, read_json, verify
from .terrain_prepare import plan, prepare, _plan


def plan_from_workspace(root, workspace, *, reference_collection_id, reference_source_id,
                        domain_collection_id, domain_source_id, domain_layer=None, domain_where=None,
                        source_ids=None, buffer_m=1000, title="Upper Savannah retained terrain", **options):
    """Reuse the original grid writer, source views, geometry and exact selection.

    `workspace` is the existing model.workspace.Workspace instance. No operator
    server or Workspace class is patched, and no replacement grid is introduced.
    """
    from .raster_sources import source_grid
    reference, reference_entry = workspace.source_file(reference_collection_id,reference_source_id)
    domain, domain_entry = workspace.source_file(domain_collection_id,domain_source_id)
    if reference_entry["kind"] != "raster" or domain_entry["kind"] != "vector":
        raise TerrainError("Select the existing numeric reference raster and model-domain vector")
    layer = domain_layer or domain_entry.get("layer")
    grid = source_grid(reference,domain,layer=layer,where=domain_where,buffer_m=buffer_m)
    source_reference = {"workspace_id":workspace.project["id"],
                        "reference":{"collection_id":reference_collection_id,"source_id":reference_source_id},
                        "domain":{"collection_id":domain_collection_id,"source_id":domain_source_id,
                                  "layer":layer,"where":domain_where},
                        "buffer_m":buffer_m,"grid_writer":"source_tools.raster_sources.source_grid"}
    return plan(root,grid,title=title,domain_path=domain,domain_layer=layer,domain_where=domain_where,
                source_ids=source_ids,reference_path=reference,source_reference=source_reference,**options)


def import_into_workspace(root,plan_id,workspace):
    """Import through the original source writer, reusing an identical prior import."""
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    _plan(root,plan_id)
    manifest = root/("sources-"+plan_id+".json")
    value = read_json(manifest)
    if value.get("schema") != "upstate.sources/v1":
        raise TerrainError("Select the completed native terrain source manifest")
    for entry in value["entries"]:
        for member in [entry]+entry.get("companions",[]):
            verify(root,member)
    stamp = describe(root,manifest)
    existing = [collection for collection in workspace.sources()
                if collection.get("original_manifest",{}).get("sha256") == stamp["sha256"]]
    if existing:
        collection = existing[0]
        reused = True
    else:
        collection = workspace.import_sources(manifest)
        reused = False
    # Open the native source view as part of receiving, checking original byte retention.
    selected_id = value["entries"][0]["id"]
    original, entry = workspace.source_file(collection["id"], selected_id)
    return {"source_collection_id":collection["id"], "source_id":selected_id,
            "path":str(original), "units":entry["units"], "plan_id":plan_id,"reused":reused}


def prepare_and_import(root,plan_id,workspace,*,progress=None):
    result = prepare(root,plan_id,progress=progress)
    if result["state"] != "complete":
        return result
    return {**result,"workspace_source":import_into_workspace(root,plan_id,workspace)}

Abstract

The rainfall-runoff erosivity factor (R-Factor) quantifies the effects of raindrop impacts and reflects the amount and rate of runoff associated with the rain. The R-factor is one of the parameters used by the Revised Unified Soil Loss Equation (RUSLE) to estimate annual rates of erosion. This product is a raster representation of R-Factor derived from isoerodent maps published in the Agriculture Handbook Number 703 (Renard et al.,1997). Lines connecting points of equal rainfall ersoivity are called isoerodents. The iserodents plotted on a map of the coterminous U.S. were digitized, then values between these lines were obtained by linear interpolation. The final R-Factor data are in raster GeoTiff format at 800 meter resolution in Albers Conic Equal Area, GRS80, NAD83.

Purpose

These data are represented in raster format for use with the Open source Nonpoint Source Pollution and Erosion Comparison Tool (OpenNSPECT).

## Continue the original input

Use the existing file above through the receiving worker's normal authorized Slack file route. From the installed application, set `NOAA_ARCHIVE` to its actual local path and `SOURCE_ROOT` to the existing project root containing the retained original inputs and selected grid. Run the maintained commands:

```sh
python -B -m source_tools.erosivity_sources receive \
  --archive "$NOAA_ARCHIVE" \
  --transfer source/noaa-r-factor-conus-2013/source-transfer.json \
  --metadata source/noaa-r-factor-conus-2013/metadata.html \
  --metadata-receipt source/noaa-r-factor-conus-2013/metadata.html.capture.json \
  --output "$SOURCE_ROOT/noaa-r-received"

python -B -m source_tools.erosivity_sources prepare \
  --capture-directory "$SOURCE_ROOT/noaa-r-received" \
  --output "$SOURCE_ROOT/noaa-r-prepared"
```

The resulting `$SOURCE_ROOT/noaa-r-prepared/source-entry.json` selects the original numeric TIFF and declares its band scale and conversion. It joins the existing source composer directly. For the selected regional grid, use the same maintained climate preparation with the actual retained `REGIONAL_GRID_JSON` path:

```sh
python -B -m source_tools.climate_region \
  --project-root "$SOURCE_ROOT" \
  --grid "$REGIONAL_GRID_JSON" \
  --erosivity-entry "$SOURCE_ROOT/noaa-r-prepared/source-entry.json"
```

This produces the regional SI raster, derivation and ordinary source manifest used by the native SDR programme. The common project root must contain the original entry, companions, selected grid and output. Continue the same output directories to reuse completed preparation.

## Physical units in the maintained intake

NOAA's [original metadata](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/inport/item/48224/full-list) declares `(hundreds ft-tonf-in)/(ac-h-yr)`. The official [InVEST 3.20 SDR guide](https://storage.googleapis.com/releases.naturalcapitalproject.org/invest/3.20.0/userguide/en/sdr.html#rainfall-erosivity-index-r) specifies multiplication by **17.02** to obtain `MJ*mm/(ha*h*year)`.

The native-source preparation retains the original TIFF bytes and composes `original band scale × 17.02` in its conversion entry. The maintained raster aligner multiplies valid stored values once, retains NoData, and includes the conversion in its interrupted-tile identity. The regional climate output then declares SI units and retains the applied conversion as provenance; its top-level entry has no further multiplier.

The original 800 metre resolution and historical source period remain attached when this field is placed on the 30 metre working grid. Keep the named R-source edition with the soil, cover and native-parameter choices when reviewing the resulting sediment outputs.

    <descript>
      <abstract>This tile of the 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) seamless products is 1 Arc Second resolution.  3DEP data serve as the elevation layer of The National Map, and provide basic elevation information for Earth science studies and mapping applications in the United States. Scientists and resource managers use 3DEP data for global change research, hydrologic modeling, resource monitoring, mapping and visualization, and many other applications. 3DEP data compose an elevation dataset that consists of seamless layers and a high resolution layer.  Each of these layers consists of the best available raster elevation data of the conterminous United States, Alaska, Hawaii, territorial islands, Mexico and Canada.  3DEP data are updated continually as new data become available. Seamless 3DEP data are derived from diverse source data that are processed to a common coordinate system and unit of vertical measure. These data are distributed in geographic coordinates in units of decimal degrees, and in conformance with the North American Datum of 1983 (NAD 83). All elevation values are in meters and, over the conterminous United States, are referenced to the North American Vertical Datum of 1988 (NAVD 88). The vertical reference will vary in other areas. Seamless 3DEP data are available nationally (except for Alaska) at resolutions of 1 arc-second (approximately 30 meters) and 1/3 arc-second (approximately 10 meters). In most of Alaska, only lower resolution source data are available. As a result, most seamless 3DEP data for Alaska are at 2 arc-second (approximately 60 meters) grid spacing. Part of Alaska is available at the 1 and 1/3 arc-second resolutions from interferometric synthetic aperture radar (ifsar) collections starting in 2010.  Plans are in place for collection of statewide ifsar in Alaska. All 3DEP products are public domain.</abstract>
